issue.sentenceEn: If that sounds melodramatic, consider this: The Art Directors Guild, a labor union representing about 3,000 film workers, has suspended a training program and issued a statement explaining that "we cannot in good conscience encourage you to pursue our profession."
issue.translationZh: 如果这听起来有些夸大其词，请考虑这样一个事实：代表约 3000 名电影从业者的工会——美国艺术指导工会，已经暂停了一项培训计划，并发布声明称：“凭良心讲，我们无法鼓励你们从事这一职业。”
issue.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

issue.sentenceEn: As summarized in a recent post on "The Hidden Dangers of Online Beauty Filters", relying on this technology for social presentation can cause harm such as body image issues , lower self-esteem, and social anxiety.
issue.translationZh: 正如最近一篇题为《在线美颜滤镜的隐藏风险》的博文所总结的那样，在社交展示中依赖这种技术可能会造成损害，例如身体意象问题、自卑以及社交焦虑。
issue.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

issue.sentenceEn: "This is a really, really critical issue for restoration in Southeast Asia, because many of the most important timber species and tree species — the ones that will lock up the most carbon — they're all masting species."
issue.translationZh: 对于东南亚的生态修复工作而言，这是一个极其关键的问题。因为许多最重要的木材物种和树种——也就是那些固碳能力最强的树种——全部都属于‘大年结实’物种。
issue.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第5句

issue.sentenceEn: In general, an HAP spells out when and how officials should issue heat warnings and alert hospitals and other institutions.
issue.translationZh: 一般而言，高温行动计划(HAP)规定了官员应何时以及如何发布高温预警，并向医院和其他机构发出警报。
issue.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

issue.sentenceEn: Karla Ortiz, an illustrator based in San Francisco who found her work in Stable Diffusion's data set, has been raising awareness about the issues around AI art and copyright.
issue.translationZh: 卡拉·奥尔蒂斯是一位常驻旧金山的插画师，她发现自己的作品被纳入了Stable Diffusion的数据集，一直以来都在提高人们对AI艺术和版权相关问题的认识。
issue.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

issue.sentenceEn: Major social issues should be the focus of legislation.
issue.translationZh: 重大社会问题应成为立法的重点。

involve.sentenceEn: The randomised control trial involved hundreds of year 5 pupils aged nine and ten—at 45 state primary schools that had not been "previously exposed to RSC pedagogy".
involve.translationZh: 这项随机对照试验涉及45所州立小学的数百名9至10岁五年级学生，这些学校此前"未接触过皇家莎士比亚剧团教学法"。
involve.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

involve.sentenceEn: But now piracy involving illegal streaming services as well as file-sharing costs the US economy about $30 billion in lost revenue a year and some 250,000 jobs, estimates the US Chamber of Commerce's Global Innovation Policy Center.
involve.translationZh: 但美国商会全球创新政策中心估计，如今涉及非法流媒体服务和文件共享的盗版行为每年给美国经济造成约300亿美元的收入损失，并导致约25万个就业岗位流失。
involve.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

involve.sentenceEn: Perhaps most encouraging of all is a paper from 2022 by researchers at Stanford University that involved a mix of contrived help-seeking interactions and asking people to recall times they'd sought help in the past.
involve.translationZh: 或许最令人鼓舞的是斯坦福大学研究人员2022年发表的一篇论文，该研究结合了人为设计的求助互动实验和要求人们回忆过去求助经历的调查。
involve.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

involve.sentenceEn: It involves communicating a need on your part—there's something you can't do.
involve.translationZh: 这涉及表达你自身的需求——有些事情你无法完成。
involve.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

involve.sentenceEn: The group is in its early days of mobilization, which could involve pushing for new policies or regulation.
involve.translationZh: 该团体正处于动员初期，未来可能会推动新政策或法规的制定。
involve.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第2句

involve.sentenceEn: The purpose of restoration efforts may be different from the real needs of the people involved .
involve.translationZh: 修复工作的目的可能与相关人员的实际需求存在偏差。

individual.sentenceEn: Individuals can now experiment with different looks and explore their preferences, potentially expanding the range of beauty ideals.
individual.translationZh: 现在，人们可以尝试不同的形象并探索个人偏好，这有可能进一步拓宽审美标准的范围。
individual.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

individual.sentenceEn: This customized approach aims to cater to individual preferences and enhance the concept of beauty tailored to each person's unique characteristics.
individual.translationZh: 这种定制化方法旨在迎合个人喜好，并根据每个人的独特特质提升个性化的美学理念。
individual.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

individual.sentenceEn: There's also a knowledge gap that needs to be addressed — 40% of individuals surveyed are unsure about who retains ownership over the content produced by AI.
individual.translationZh: 此外，还存在一个亟待解决的认知鸿沟——40% 的受访者不确定 AI 生成内容的归属权究竟属于谁。
individual.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

individual.sentenceEn: "I think individuals being able to rent out their second home is a good thing. If it's their vacation home anyway, and it's just empty, why can't you make money off it?" Hom said.
individual.translationZh: 霍姆表示：“我认为个人能够出租他们的第二套住房是件好事。既然那本来就是他们的度假屋，而且大部分时间都空置着，为什么不能用它来赚点钱呢？”
individual.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

individual.sentenceEn: In one example, an individual —acting as author, editor, and consultant—was able to use at least 15 journals as citation providers to articles published by five scientists at three universities.
individual.translationZh: 举个例子，有个人身兼作者、编辑和顾问三职，竟然能利用至少15家期刊为三所大学的五位科学家发表的文章提供引用。
individual.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

individual.sentenceEn: They put too much burden on individual motorists.
individual.translationZh: 它们将过多负担加在了个体驾车者身上。

impact.sentenceEn: Additionally, clothing can impact our confidence levels.
impact.translationZh: 此外，穿着打扮也会影响我们的自信程度。
impact.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

impact.sentenceEn: The global impact is about $71 billion annually.
impact.translationZh: 其全球影响每年约为710亿美元。
impact.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

impact.sentenceEn: Yet, reluctance persists among other planners to integrate desire paths into formal plans, citing concerns about safety, environmental impact , or primarily, aesthetics.
impact.translationZh: 然而，其他规划者仍然不愿意将这些"欲望路径"纳入正式规划中，他们提出的理由包括安全隐患、环境影响，或者最主要的是美观问题。
impact.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

impact.sentenceEn: Researchers analysed the frequency and impact of gaps greater than 2 seconds during conversations, including an overview of previous studies which indicate that the fear of awkward silences can be so extreme that people avoid talking to strangers, even though doing so is likely to be an enjoyable experience.
impact.translationZh: 研究人员分析了对话中超过2秒的停顿频率及其影响，包括对先前研究的综述。这些研究表明，人们对尴尬沉默的恐惧可能非常强烈，以至于会避免与陌生人交谈，尽管这样的交谈很可能是一次愉快的体验。
impact.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

impact.sentenceEn: Pennsylvania farmers, to use one telling example, aren't thinking about next year's blue crab harvest in Maryland when they decide whether to spread animal waste on their fields, yet the runoff into nearby creeks can have enormous impact downstream.
impact.translationZh: 举一个典型的例子，宾夕法尼亚州的农民在决定是否在田地里撒动物粪便时，不会考虑到马里兰州来年的蓝蟹收成，然而流入附近小溪的径流却可能对下游产生巨大影响。
impact.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

impact.sentenceEn: It may impact our society negatively.
impact.translationZh: 有些人担心这会对社会产生破坏性影响

internet.sentenceEn: But these open-source programs are built by scraping images from the Internet , often without permission and proper attribution to artists.
internet.translationZh: 但这些开源程序是通过从互联网上抓取图片构建而成的，而且往往未获得艺术家的许可，也未给予他们应有的署名。
internet.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

internet.sentenceEn: "It's been just a month. What about in a year? I probably won't be able to find my work out there because the Internet will be flooded with AI art," Rutkowski said.
internet.translationZh: 鲁特科夫斯基说：“这才一个月。要是过一年呢？我可能就再也找不到自己的作品了，因为互联网上会充斥着人工智能生成的艺术作品。”
internet.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

internet.sentenceEn: Perhaps, she suggests, the trend will change our approach to learning from a focus on individual facts and memorization to an emphasis on more conceptual thinking—something that is not available on the Internet .
internet.translationZh: 她认为，这种趋势或许会改变我们的学习方式——从专注于单个事实和死记硬背，转向更注重概念性思考，而这正是互联网无法提供的。
internet.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

internet.sentenceEn: Still other experts say it's too soon to understand how the Internet affects our brains.
internet.translationZh: 还有其他专家表示，现在就去理解互联网如何影响我们的大脑还为时过早。
internet.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

internet.sentenceEn: The Internet may be changing merely what we remember, not our capacity to do so, suggests Columbia University psychology professor Betsy Sparrow.
internet.translationZh: 哥伦比亚大学心理学教授贝齐·斯派洛指出，互联网可能仅仅改变了我们记忆的内容，而非我们的记忆能力。
internet.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

internet.sentenceEn: Which of the following would Sparrow support about the Internet ?
internet.translationZh: 关于互联网，斯派罗会支持以下哪项观点？

intelligence.sentenceEn: Advances in artificial intelligence (AI) are rapidly changing every aspect of human life.
intelligence.translationZh: 人工智能（AI）的进步正在迅速改变人类生活的方方面面。
intelligence.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

intelligence.sentenceEn: Every day, scientists, technologists and engineers are discovering new ways to exploit renewable energy sources and develop techniques not just to use power more intelligently but to power our intelligence .
intelligence.translationZh: 每天，科学家、技术专家和工程师都在探索利用可再生能源的新方法，并开发相关技术——不仅是为了更智能地使用能源，也是为了用能源驱动我们的智能发展。
intelligence.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

intelligence.sentenceEn: There has been some exploration around the use of artificial intelligence (AI) in digital marketing.
intelligence.translationZh: 目前已有一些关于在数字营销中运用人工智能(AI)的探索。
intelligence.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

intelligence.sentenceEn: There may have been many spies and intelligence officers during the Napoleonic Wars, but it is usually extremely difficult to find the material they actually provided or worked on.
intelligence.translationZh: 拿破仑战争期间，间谍和情报官员或许为数众多，但要找到他们实际提供或处理过的材料通常极其困难。
intelligence.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

intelligence.sentenceEn: As I researched Scovell's story I found far more of interest besides his intelligence work.
intelligence.translationZh: 在研究斯科维尔的生平事迹时，我发现除了他的情报工作外，还有许多同样引人入胜的内容。
intelligence.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

intelligence.sentenceEn: The idea that plants have some degree of consciousness first took root in the early 2000s; the term "plant neurobiology" was coined around the notion that some aspects of plant behavior could be compared to intelligence in animals.
intelligence.translationZh: 植物具有某种程度意识的观点最早在21世纪初开始扎根；"植物神经生物学"这一术语的创造正是基于这样一种概念，即植物行为的某些方面可以与动物的智力相比较。
intelligence.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

intellectual.sentenceEn: There are libraries with business and intellectual property centres, which can help business owners and entrepreneurs.
intellectual.translationZh: 一些图书馆设有商业和知识产权中心，可以为企业主和创业者提供帮助。
intellectual.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

intellectual.sentenceEn: The publishing industry talks about diversity in terms of authors and staff but it also needs a plurality of ways of delivering intellectual contact, choice and different voices.
intellectual.translationZh: 出版业在谈论作者和员工的多样性，但它也需要多种方式来实现知识交流、提供选择和展现不同声音。
intellectual.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

intellectual.sentenceEn: "I personally have never seen all that much intellectual value in memorizing things," Sparrow says, adding that we haven't lost our ability to do it.
intellectual.translationZh: 斯派洛说：“我个人从不认为记忆事物有那么多的智力价值。”她补充道，我们并没有失去记忆能力。
intellectual.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第6句

intellectual.sentenceEn: And if the postgraduate student population also grows rapidly and there is loss of a close apprenticeship relationship between faculty members and students, the student culture becomes the chief socializing force for new postgraduate students, with consequences for the intellectual and academic life of the institution-this was seen in America as well as in France, Italy, West Germany, and Japan.
intellectual.translationZh: 而如果研究生人数也迅速增长，师生间紧密的师徒关系逐渐消失，那么学生文化就会成为新研究生的主要社会化力量，这将对院校的知识生活和学术生活产生影响——这种现象不仅在美国出现，在法国、意大利、西德和日本也同样存在。
intellectual.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

intellectual.sentenceEn: with the Church's teachings and ways of thinking eclipsed by the Renaissance, the gap between the Medieval and modern periods had been bridged leading to new and unexplored intellectual territories.
intellectual.translationZh: 随着教会的教义与思维方式在文艺复兴的光芒下黯然失色，中世纪与现代之间的鸿沟得以弥合，从而开拓出全新的、未被探索的知识领域。
intellectual.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

intellectual.sentenceEn: These days, because leisure time is relatively scarce for most workers, people use their free time to counterbalance the intellectual and emotional demands of their jobs.
intellectual.translationZh: 如今，由于大多数劳动者的闲暇时间相对稀缺，人们便利用业余时间来平衡工作带来的智力和情感需求。
intellectual.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

image.translationZh: 问起人们对公共图书馆的看法，脑海中总会浮现出某种特定画面：尘土飞扬、陈旧过时。就像那种你小时候很喜欢，但现在是否还会光顾的地方——某种程度上，就和英国的海滨小镇一样。

image.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

image.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

image.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

increasingly.sentenceEn: Battles increasingly depended on new military technologies such as radar and the proximity fuze.
increasingly.translationZh: 战争日益依赖于雷达和近炸引信等新型军事技术。

increasingly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

increasingly.sentenceEn: These collaborations are likely to become increasingly common.
increasingly.translationZh: 此类合作很可能会变得越来越普遍。

increasingly.translationZh: 交通中断已变得日益频繁，火车晚期现已成为意大利媒体报道中的常态。

increasingly.sentenceEn: With more than 6.8 million on waitlists, healthcare is becoming increasingly inaccessible for those who cannot opt to pay for private treatment; and the cost of providing healthcare is increasingly squeezing out investment in other public services.
increasingly.translationZh: 等待名单上的人数已超过680万，对于那些无法选择私人医疗服务的人来说，医疗资源变得越来越难以获取；同时，医疗服务的提供成本不断攀升，正逐渐挤占其他公共服务的投资空间。
increasingly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

increasingly.sentenceEn: It is increasingly easy to read donkeys' DNA sequences.
increasingly.translationZh: 读取驴的 DNA 序列正变得越来越容易。

institution.translationZh: 没有任何其他机构，无论是公立还是私营，能得出同样的结论。

institution.sentenceEn: These groups of people are part of a rapidly expanding biotechnological social movement of citizen scientists and professional scientists seeking to take discovery out of institutions and put it into the hands of anyone with the enthusiasm.

institution.translationZh: 简而言之，尼日利亚有些人无法前往史密森学会，去亲眼目睹贝宁青铜器所代表的那部分本国历史与文化。
institution.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

institution.sentenceEn: Students who stand out in a specific extracurricular activity will be favored by top-tier institutions .
institution.translationZh: 在特定课外活动中表现突出的学生将受到顶尖院校的青睐。

investment.sentenceEn: Transport economist Andrea Giuricin said the planned investments would bring improvements but disruptions in the meantime were inevitable.
investment.translationZh: 交通经济学家安德烈亚·朱里钦表示，计划中的投资将带来改善，但在此期间，交通中断将不可避免。

investment.sentenceEn: RFI, the network operator, is the single largest European recovery fund beneficiary with planned investments of €24bn by 2026.

investment.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

investment.sentenceEn: Cooper and her colleagues argue that the success of the crown for Hull, where it brought in £220m of investment and an avalanche of arts, ought not to be confined to cities.

income.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

illustrate.sentenceEn: With characteristic confidence, Dickens successfully insisted that Seymour's pictures illustrate his own story instead.
illustrate.translationZh: 狄更斯以其特有的自信，坚持要求西摩的插画应转而描绘他自己的故事，这一要求最终获得了成功。

illustrate.sentenceEn: Two- and three-dimensional maps are helpful tools in planning excavations, illustrating how sites look, and presenting the results of archaeological research.
illustrate.translationZh: 二维和三维地图是规划挖掘工作、展示遗址面貌以及呈现考古研究成果的有用工具。

illustrate.sentenceEn: In the past couple of weeks a quarrel has illustrated the value to advertisers of such fine-grained information: Should advertisers assume that people are happy to be tracked and sent behavioural ads?
illustrate.translationZh: 过去几周，一场争论凸显了此类精细信息对广告商的价值：广告商是否应该假定用户愿意被追踪并接收行为定向广告？
illustrate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

illustrate.sentenceEn: Once you have a first draft on paper, you can delete material that is unrelated to your thesis and add material necessary to illustrate your points and make your paper convincing.
illustrate.translationZh: 一旦你完成了初稿，就可以删除与论文主题无关的内容，并添加必要的材料来阐明你的观点，使论文更具说服力。
illustrate.paperLabel: 考研英语 2008 英语（未分卷）
illustrate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

illustrate.sentenceEn: Illustrated with an entertaining array of examples from both high and low culture, the trend that Mr. McWhorter documents is unmistakable.
illustrate.translationZh: 麦克沃特先生通过一系列来自高雅文化和通俗文化的有趣例子阐述了这一趋势，其存在是毋庸置疑的。
illustrate.paperLabel: 考研英语 2005 英语（未分卷）
illustrate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

illustrate.sentenceEn: The example of Green in Paragraph 5 is used to illustrate ________.
illustrate.translationZh: 第5段中的格林的例子是用来说明________。

indicate.sentenceEn: Researchers analysed the frequency and impact of gaps greater than 2 seconds during conversations, including an overview of previous studies which indicate that the fear of awkward silences can be so extreme that people avoid talking to strangers, even though doing so is likely to be an enjoyable experience.
indicate.translationZh: 研究人员分析了对话中超过2秒的停顿频率及其影响，包括对先前研究的综述。这些研究表明，人们对尴尬沉默的恐惧可能非常强烈，以至于会避免与陌生人交谈，尽管这样的交谈很可能是一次愉快的体验。
indicate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

indicate.sentenceEn: "Our findings indicate that people do not only feel different when they are the centre of attention but that their brain reactions also differ."
indicate.translationZh: 我们的研究结果表明，当人们成为关注的焦点时，他们不仅会有不同的感受，其大脑反应也会有所不同。
indicate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第11段，第2句

indicate.sentenceEn: "This indicates there is a real personal responsibility in counteracting this problem," says Roxanne Stone, editor in chief at Barna Group.
indicate.translationZh: 巴纳集团总编辑罗克珊·斯通表示：“这表明，在应对这一问题上，个人确实负有重大责任。”
indicate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第6句

indicate.sentenceEn: The ways of reading indicated here are without doubt kinds of comprehension.
indicate.translationZh: 毫无疑问，这里所指的种种阅读方式都属于理解活动。
indicate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

indicate.sentenceEn: Studies dating back to the 1930s indicate that laughter relaxes muscles, decreasing muscle tone for up to 45 minutes after the laugh dies down.
indicate.translationZh: 早在20世纪30年代的研究就表明，笑能放松肌肉，在笑声停止后，肌肉张力的降低可持续长达45分钟。
indicate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

indicate.sentenceEn: The brain finds it best to keep smell receptors available for unfamiliar and emergency signals such as the smell of smoke, which might indicate the danger of fire.
indicate.translationZh: 大脑会让嗅觉感受器随时准备接收陌生和紧急信号，例如可能意味着火灾危险的烟味。
indicate.paperLabel: 考研英语 2005 英语（未分卷）
indicate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

infrastructure.sentenceEn: The huge improvements in Italy's obsolete infrastructure partly explained the disruption, said Ferrovie.
infrastructure.translationZh: 意大利国家铁路公司表示，该国陈旧基础设施的大规模改造工程是造成交通中断的部分原因。
infrastructure.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

infrastructure.sentenceEn: Ferrovie will invest a total of €124bn in infrastructure over the next 10 years.
infrastructure.translationZh: 意大利国家铁路公司（Ferrovie）将在未来10年内投入总计1240亿欧元的资金用于基础设施建设。
infrastructure.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

infrastructure.sentenceEn: Christopher Kettle, Biodiversity International's director for forest genetic resources and restoration in Rome, says that the need for infrastructure — things such as mechanisms for collecting and storing seeds, and nurseries to raise seedlings — might be most desperate here because many trees are 'masting' species, which don't produce seeds every year.
infrastructure.translationZh: 位于罗马的国际生物多样性中心森林遗传资源与修复主管克里斯托弗·凯特尔表示，这里对基础设施（如种子采集和储存机制，以及培育幼苗的苗圃）的需求最为迫切，因为许多树木属于“大年结实”物种，并不会每年都产种。
infrastructure.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

infrastructure.sentenceEn: Roads, trails, restrooms, visitor centers and other infrastructure are crumbling.
infrastructure.translationZh: 道路、步道、卫生间、游客中心及其他基础设施都在日渐破败。
infrastructure.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

infrastructure.sentenceEn: Campgrounds are a tiny portion of the overall infrastructure backlog, and businesses in the parks hand over, on average, only about 5% of their revenues to the National Park Service.
infrastructure.translationZh: 营地只是整体基础设施维修积压项目中的一小部分，而园区内企业平均仅将约5%的收入上缴国家公园管理局。
infrastructure.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

infrastructure.sentenceEn: Equally, there is a sense that the travails of commuters in the South East, many of whom will face among the biggest rises, have received too much attention compared to those who must endure the relatively poor infrastructure of the Midlands and the North.
infrastructure.translationZh: 同样，有一种观点认为，东南部通勤者的艰辛——其中许多人将面临最大幅度的票价上涨——获得的关注过多，而相比之下，中部和北部地区那些必须忍受相对落后基础设施的人们却关注不足。
infrastructure.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

ignore.sentenceEn: "The American Medical Association advises physicians that 'in situations where clear evidence of substantial driving impairment implies a strong threat to patient and public safety, and where the physician's advice to discontinue driving privileges is ignored , it is desirable and ethical to notify the Department of Motor Vehicles,'" Menke wrote.
ignore.translationZh: 门克写道：'美国医学协会建议医生，'当有明确证据表明驾驶员存在严重驾驶障碍，对患者本人及公共安全构成严重威胁，且医生关于终止驾驶特权的建议被忽视时，通知机动车管理部门是可取且符合伦理的做法。'
ignore.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

ignore.sentenceEn: Despite attempts by the Church to suppress this new generation of logicians and rationalists, more explanations for how the universe functioned were being made at a rate that the people could no longer ignore .
ignore.translationZh: 尽管教会试图压制新一代的逻辑学家和理性主义者，但关于宇宙运行规律的解释却以前所未有的速度涌现，人们再也无法视而不见。
ignore.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

ignore.sentenceEn: While the conversation around our environment and our responsibility toward it remains centered on shopping bags and straws, we're ignoring the balance of power that implies that as "consumers" we must shop sustainably, rather than as "citizens" hold our governments and industries to account to push for real systemic change.
ignore.translationZh: 当我们围绕环境及其责任的讨论仍停留在购物袋和吸管这类琐事上时，我们忽视了权力的平衡——这种平衡暗示着作为"消费者"，我们必须以可持续方式购物，而非作为"公民"要求政府和企业承担责任，推动真正的系统性变革。
ignore.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

ignore.sentenceEn: Calls to disassemble all telescopes on Mauna Kea or to ban future development there ignore the reality that astronomy and Hawaiian culture both seek to answer big questions about who we are, where we come from and where we are going.
ignore.translationZh: 要求拆除莫纳克亚山上所有望远镜或禁止未来在那里进行开发的呼声忽视了一个事实：天文学和夏威夷文化都在试图回答关于我们是谁、我们来自何方以及我们要去往何处的重大问题。
ignore.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

ignore.sentenceEn: The commission ignores that for several decades America's colleges and universities have produced graduates who don't know the content and character of liberal education and are thus deprived of its benefits.
ignore.translationZh: 该委员会忽视了这样一个事实：几十年来，美国的高等院校培养出的毕业生并不了解人文教育的内涵和特点，因此也无法从中受益。
ignore.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

ignore.translationZh: 快时尚产业忽视可持续发展。

immigration.sentenceEn: The complaints are unlikely to stop without an overhaul of immigration rules for farm workers.
immigration.translationZh: 除非彻底改革农场工人的移民政策，否则这些抱怨不太可能停止。
immigration.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

immigration.sentenceEn: The shortage is compounded by federal immigration raids, which remove some workers and drive others underground.
immigration.translationZh: 联邦移民突击检查加剧了劳动力短缺问题，这些检查驱离了部分工人，并迫使其他人转入地下。
immigration.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第5句

immigration.sentenceEn: The United States is the product of two principal forces – the immigration of European peoples with their varied ideas, customs, and national characteristics and the impact of a new country which modified these traits.
immigration.translationZh: 美国是两种主要力量共同作用的产物——一是带着各种思想、习俗和民族特质的欧洲移民潮，二是这个新国家对这些特质所产生的影响。
immigration.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

immigration.sentenceEn: But if Congress wanted to prevent states from using their own resources to check immigration status, it could.
immigration.translationZh: 但如果国会想要阻止各州动用自身资源来核查移民身份，它完全有这个权力。
immigration.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

immigration.sentenceEn: On a five to three vote, the Supreme Court knocked out much of Arizona's immigration law Monday – a modest policy victory for the Obama Administration.
immigration.translationZh: 美国最高法院周一以5票对3票的表决结果，否决了亚利桑那州移民法的大部分内容——这对奥巴马政府而言是一场不大不小的政策胜利。
immigration.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

immigration.sentenceEn: The Administration is dominant over immigration issues.
immigration.translationZh: 联邦政府在移民事务上拥有主导权。

interaction.sentenceEn: Clothing is not just about covering our bodies; it plays a significant role in shaping our self-perception and interactions with others.
interaction.translationZh: 服装不仅是为了遮体，它在塑造自我认知以及与他人互动方面也起着至关重要的作用。
interaction.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

interaction.sentenceEn: Perhaps most encouraging of all is a paper from 2022 by researchers at Stanford University that involved a mix of contrived help-seeking interactions and asking people to recall times they'd sought help in the past.
interaction.translationZh: 或许最令人鼓舞的是斯坦福大学研究人员2022年发表的一篇论文，该研究结合了人为设计的求助互动实验和要求人们回忆过去求助经历的调查。
interaction.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

interaction.sentenceEn: The miracle of the Chesapeake Bay lies not in its depths, but in the complexity of its natural construction, the interaction of fresh and saline waters, and the mix of land and water.
interaction.translationZh: 切萨皮克湾的奇迹不在于其深度，而在于其复杂的自然构造、淡水与咸水的交汇融合，以及陆地与水域的相互交织。
interaction.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

interaction.sentenceEn: Data can be gathered on where the customer can be engaged, such as location, devices used, website interactions , and sites visited, to display marketing messages in appropriate forms, including emails, social media posts, pop-up advertisements, and banners at an appropriate frequency.
interaction.translationZh: 可以收集有关客户互动渠道的数据，例如位置、使用的设备、网站交互和访问过的站点，以便以适当的形式（包括电子邮件、社交媒体帖子、弹窗广告和横幅）并按适当的频率展示营销信息。
interaction.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第5句

interaction.sentenceEn: As a result, these structures became important centres for cultural exchange and interaction , with travellers sharing their cultures, ideas and beliefs, as well as taking knowledge with them, greatly influencing the development of several civilisations.
interaction.translationZh: 因此，这些建筑成为了文化交流与互动的重要中心。旅行者们在此分享各自的文化、思想和信仰，同时也带走知识，这对多个文明的发展产生了深远影响。
interaction.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

interaction.sentenceEn: Rather, we ascribe meanings to texts on the basis of interaction between what we might call textual and contextual material: between kinds of organization or patterning we perceive in a text's formal structures (so especially its language structures) and various kinds of background, social knowledge, belief and attitude that we bring to the text.
interaction.translationZh: 相反，我们赋予文本意义是基于我们所谓的文本材料与语境材料之间的互动：一方面是我们在文本形式结构（尤其是语言结构）中感知到的各种组织方式或模式，另一方面是我们带入文本的各种背景知识、社会认知、信念和态度。

impose.sentenceEn: Yet the FCC also ended the investigations of broadband providers that imposed data caps on their rivals' streaming services but not their own.
impose.translationZh: 然而，联邦通信委员会也终止了对宽带服务商的调查，这些服务商对竞争对手的流媒体服务设置了数据上限，却对自家服务网开一面。
impose.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

impose.sentenceEn: It has become a grimly reliable annual ritual: every January the cost of travelling by train rises, imposing a significant extra burden on those who have no option but to use the rail network to get to work or otherwise.
impose.translationZh: 这已经成了一个令人沮丧却又如期而至的年度惯例：每年一月，火车票价都会上涨，给那些别无选择、只能依靠铁路通勤上班或出行的人们带来沉重的额外负担。
impose.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

impose.sentenceEn: In order to ensure that elite women have more such opportunities, they have proposed imposing government quotas.
impose.translationZh: 为了确保精英女性获得更多此类机会，他们提议实施政府配额制度。
impose.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

impose.sentenceEn: Last Thursday, the French Senate passed a digital services tax, which would impose an entirely new tax on large multinationals that provide digital services to consumers or users in France.
impose.translationZh: 上周四，法国参议院通过了一项数字服务税，该税将对向法国消费者或用户提供数字服务的大型跨国公司征收全新税费。
impose.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

impose.sentenceEn: Financial regulators in Britain have imposed a rather unusual rule on the bosses of big banks.
impose.translationZh: 英国金融监管机构对大型银行的高管们实施了一项颇为不同寻常的规定。
impose.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

impose.sentenceEn: "fat taxes" should be imposed on fast-food producers such as McDonald's.
impose.translationZh: 应该对麦当劳等快餐生产商征收“脂肪税”。

ideal.sentenceEn: Individuals can now experiment with different looks and explore their preferences, potentially expanding the range of beauty ideals .
ideal.translationZh: 现在，人们可以尝试不同的形象并探索个人偏好，这有可能进一步拓宽审美标准的范围。
ideal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

ideal.sentenceEn: Instead of saying what is wrong, broken, or suboptimal, talk about what is right, fixable, or ideal .
ideal.translationZh: 与其谈论问题、不足或不够理想之处，不如多说说积极面、可改进的地方或理想状态。
ideal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第11段，第2句

ideal.sentenceEn: The UK has ideal conditions for growing wood to build low-carbon homes and is a global leader in certifying that its forests are sustainably managed, Confor says.
ideal.translationZh: 英国森林工业联合会表示，英国拥有种植木材以建造低碳住宅的理想条件，并且在森林可持续管理认证方面处于全球领先地位。
ideal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

ideal.sentenceEn: Scientific method, reductionism and the questioning of Church ideals was to be encouraged, as were ideas of liberty, tolerance and progress.
ideal.translationZh: 科学方法、还原论和对教会理念的质疑应当得到鼓励，自由、宽容和进步的思想亦是如此。
ideal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

ideal.sentenceEn: Relying on ethical persuasion rather than law to address the misuse of body ideals may be the best step.
ideal.translationZh: 依靠道德劝说来解决对身材理想的滥用，而非依赖法律，或许是最佳举措。
ideal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

ideal.sentenceEn: The newly revised Danish Fashion Ethical Charter clearly states: "We are aware of and take responsibility for the impact the fashion industry has on body ideals , especially on young people."
ideal.translationZh: 新修订的《丹麦时尚伦理宪章》明确指出：“我们认识到时尚产业对体型理想，尤其是对年轻人的影响，并对此承担责任。”
ideal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

improvement.sentenceEn: Transport economist Andrea Giuricin said the planned investments would bring improvements but disruptions in the meantime were inevitable.
improvement.translationZh: 交通经济学家安德烈亚·朱里钦表示，计划中的投资将带来改善，但在此期间，交通中断将不可避免。
improvement.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

improvement.sentenceEn: The huge improvements in Italy's obsolete infrastructure partly explained the disruption, said Ferrovie.
improvement.translationZh: 意大利国家铁路公司表示，该国陈旧基础设施的大规模改造工程是造成交通中断的部分原因。
improvement.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

improvement.sentenceEn: Improvements will also come from the high-density technology and satellite signalling that RFI has been investing in for years, say experts.
improvement.translationZh: 专家表示，RFI（意大利铁路网公司）多年来持续投入的高密度技术和卫星信号技术也将带来进一步的提升。
improvement.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

improvement.sentenceEn: In other words, don't throw old solutions under the bus to make your improvement stand out.
improvement.translationZh: 换句话说，不要贬低旧方案来凸显你的改进。
improvement.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第2句

improvement.sentenceEn: And despite improvements to the premium, paid version, few people were making the upgrade.
improvement.translationZh: 尽管高级付费版本已有所改进，但升级的用户寥寥无几。
improvement.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

improvement.sentenceEn: It needs someone who can unite the interdisciplinary team and keep them on course for improvement .
improvement.translationZh: 它需要一个能够团结跨学科团队并引导他们朝着改进方向前进的人。
improvement.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

inevitable.sentenceEn: Transport economist Andrea Giuricin said the planned investments would bring improvements but disruptions in the meantime were inevitable .
inevitable.translationZh: 交通经济学家安德烈亚·朱里钦表示，计划中的投资将带来改善，但在此期间，交通中断将不可避免。
inevitable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

inevitable.sentenceEn: This is not to say that there is no point in getting a degree, but rather stress that a degree is not for everyone, that the switch from classroom to lecture hall is not an inevitable one and that other options are available.
inevitable.translationZh: 这并不是说获得学位毫无意义，而是要强调学位并非适合所有人，从中学课堂到大学讲堂的转变并非必然之路，而且还有其他选择可供考虑。
inevitable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

inevitable.sentenceEn: But while aging is inevitable , scientists are finding out that certain changes in brain function may not be.
inevitable.translationZh: 但是，尽管衰老是不可避免的，科学家们却发现，大脑功能的某些变化或许并非如此。
inevitable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

inevitable.sentenceEn: And then the inevitable happens: You lose your patience and either scream at your kids or say something that was a bit too harsh and does nobody any good.
inevitable.translationZh: 然后不可避免的事情就发生了：你失去耐心，要么对着孩子大喊大叫，要么说出一些过于严厉、对谁都没有好处的话。
inevitable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

inevitable.sentenceEn: Harford argues that inevitable distractions often render the daily to-do list ineffective, while leaving room for improvisation in such a list can reap the best results.
inevitable.translationZh: 哈福德认为，不可避免的干扰往往使每日待办事项清单失去效用，而在清单中留出即兴发挥的空间则能收获最佳效果。
inevitable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

inevitable.translationZh: 能源密集型研究工作是不可避免的。

illegal.sentenceEn: With no video production costs, illegal streaming sites have achieved profit margins approaching 90%, according to the Motion Picture Association (MPA), a trade group representing Hollywood studios that's working to crack down on the thousands of illegal platforms that have cropped up in recent years.
illegal.translationZh: 据代表好莱坞各大制片厂的行业组织——美国电影协会（MPA）称，由于没有视频制作成本，非法流媒体网站的利润率已接近90%。该协会正致力于打击近年来涌现的数千个非法平台。
illegal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

illegal.sentenceEn: ACE says it's helped shrink the number of illegal streaming services in North America to 126, from more than 1,400 in 2018, aided in part by the MPA's support for a 2020 federal law that made large-scale streaming of copyrighted material a serious crime.
illegal.translationZh: 美国电影协会（ACE）表示，其已协助将北美地区的非法流媒体服务数量从2018年的1400多家减少至126家。这在一定程度上得益于MPA支持的2020年联邦法律，该法律将大规模流媒体传播受版权保护的材料定为严重犯罪。
illegal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

illegal.sentenceEn: But now piracy involving illegal streaming services as well as file-sharing costs the US economy about $30 billion in lost revenue a year and some 250,000 jobs, estimates the US Chamber of Commerce's Global Innovation Policy Center.
illegal.translationZh: 但美国商会全球创新政策中心估计，如今涉及非法流媒体服务和文件共享的盗版行为每年给美国经济造成约300亿美元的收入损失，并导致约25万个就业岗位流失。
illegal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

illegal.sentenceEn: The state Legislature recently voted against a bill that would've made it illegal for towns to create legislation restricting short-term rentals.
illegal.translationZh: 州议会最近投票否决了一项法案，该法案本将使城镇制定限制短期租赁的法规成为非法行为。
illegal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

illegal.sentenceEn: The most drastic, and thoroughly illegal , reaction has been the emergence of Sci-Hub, a kind of global photocopier for scientific papers, set up in 2012, which now claims to offer access to every paywalled article published since 2015.
illegal.translationZh: 最为极端且完全非法的回应是Sci-Hub的出现——这是一个2012年创建的全球性科学论文“复印机”，目前宣称能够提供2015年以来发表的每一篇付费墙内文章的访问权限。
illegal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

illegal.sentenceEn: This same absence of moral purpose was wounding companies such as News International, she thought, making it more likely that it would lose its way as it had with widespread illegal telephone hacking.
illegal.translationZh: 她认为，这种道德目标的缺失正损害着像新闻国际这样的公司，使其更有可能迷失方向，就像其在大规模非法电话窃听事件中那样。
illegal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

influential.sentenceEn: In his book The Tipping Point, Malcolm Gladwell argues that "social epidemics" are driven in large part by the actions of a tiny minority of special individuals, often called influentials , who are unusually informed, persuasive, or well connected.
influential.translationZh: 马尔科姆·格拉德威尔在其著作《引爆点》中提出，“社会流行潮”在很大程度上是由极少数特殊个体的行为所推动的。这些人通常被称为“影响者”，他们要么消息异常灵通，要么极具说服力，要么拥有广泛的人脉。
influential.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

influential.sentenceEn: Instead, the studies ended up giving their name to the "Hawthorne effect," the extremely influential idea that the very act of being experimented upon changed subjects' behavior.
influential.translationZh: 然而，这些研究最终却催生了一个以该工厂命名的概念——“霍桑效应”，这一极具影响力的观点认为，仅仅是成为实验对象这一行为本身就会改变受试者的行为。
influential.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

influential.sentenceEn: If people in the network just two degrees removed from the initial influential prove resistant, for example, the cascade of change won't propagate very far or affect many people.
influential.translationZh: 例如，如果社交网络中仅与初始影响者相隔两层的人表现出抵制态度，那么这一连串的变化就不会传播得很远，也不会影响很多人。
influential.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

influential.sentenceEn: Yet it is precisely these non-celebrity influentials who, according to the two-step-flow theory, are supposed to drive social epidemics, by influencing their friends and colleagues directly.
influential.translationZh: 然而，根据两级传播理论，恰恰是这些非名人影响者应该通过直接影响他们的朋友和同事来推动社会流行潮。
influential.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

influential.sentenceEn: The researchers' argument stems from a simple observation about social influence: With the exception of a few celebrities like Oprah Winfrey – whose outsize presence is primarily a function of media, not interpersonal, influence – even the most influential members of a population simply don't interact with that many others.
influential.translationZh: 研究人员的观点源于对社会影响力的一个简单观察：除了少数像奥普拉·温弗瑞这样的名人——他们的巨大影响力主要源于媒体而非人际影响——即使是一个群体中最具影响力的人物，实际上也不会与那么多人产生互动。
influential.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

influential.sentenceEn: In their recent work, however, some researchers have come up with the finding that influentials have far less impact on social epidemics than is generally supposed.
influential.translationZh: 然而，一些研究人员在近期的研究中发现，有影响力人士对社会流行现象的影响远不如人们普遍认为的那么大。
influential.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

industrial.sentenceEn: However, there is a strong case that those who have been worst affected by industrial action should receive compensation for the disruption they have suffered.
industrial.translationZh: 然而，有充分理由认为，那些受劳工行动影响最严重的乘客应该就其所遭受的出行中断获得赔偿。
industrial.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

industrial.sentenceEn: The Industrial Revolution didn't go so well for Luddites whose jobs were displaced by mechanized looms, but it eventually raised living standards and created more jobs than it destroyed.
industrial.translationZh: 工业革命对那些工作被机械化织布机取代的卢德派分子来说并不是什么好事，但它最终提高了生活水平，创造的就业机会也多于其摧毁的数量。
industrial.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

industrial.sentenceEn: This is hacking on an industrial scale, as was acknowledged by Glenn Mulcaire, the man hired by the News of the World in 2001 to be the point person for phone hacking.
industrial.translationZh: 正如2001年《世界新闻报》雇佣的电话窃听负责人格伦·穆尔凯尔所承认的那样，这是一种产业化规模的窃听行为。
industrial.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

industrial.sentenceEn: The concept of man versus machine is at least as old as the industrial revolution, but this phenomenon tends to be most acutely felt during economic downturns and fragile recoveries.
industrial.translationZh: 人机对抗这一概念至少可以追溯到工业革命时期，但这种现象在经济下行和复苏乏力时期往往表现得最为尖锐。
industrial.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

industrial.sentenceEn: Even today, in our industrial life, apart from certain values of industriousness and thrift, the intellectual and emotional reaction of the forms of human association under which the world's work is carried on receives little attention as compared with physical output.
industrial.translationZh: 即便是今天，在我们的工业生活中，除了勤劳和节俭等某些价值观外，人们对于开展世界工作所依托的人类交往形式所产生的智力和情感反应，与物质产出相比，几乎未受到任何关注。
industrial.paperLabel: 考研英语 2009 英语（未分卷）
industrial.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第6句

industrial.translationZh: 新闻记者需要更严格的行业监管。

instance.sentenceEn: For instance , as convenient and provocative, AI enables virtual try-on experiences where you can virtually test makeup, hairstyles, clothing, and even cosmetic procedures before making any physical changes.
instance.translationZh: 例如，人工智能提供了既便捷又具启发性的体验，让你在进行任何实际改变之前，能够虚拟尝试化妆、发型、服装，甚至美容整形手术。
instance.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

instance.sentenceEn: Nagpur's plan, for instance , calls for hospitals to set aside "cold wards" in the summer for treating heatstroke patients, and advises builders to give construction laborers a break from work on very hot days.
instance.translationZh: 例如，那格浦尔市的计划要求医院在夏季预留"防暑病房"以收治中暑患者，并建议建筑商在酷热天气给建筑工人停工休息。
instance.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

instance.sentenceEn: In some instances , there is absolutely no relationship between the content of the article and the citations.
instance.translationZh: 在某些情况下，文章内容与所引用文献之间毫无关联。
instance.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

instance.sentenceEn: There is no experimental evidence showing that it interferes with our ability to focus, for instance , wrote psychologists Christopher Chabris and Daniel J. Simons.
instance.translationZh: 例如，心理学家克里斯托弗·查布里斯(Christopher Chabris)和丹尼尔·J·西蒙斯(Daniel J. Simons)写道，目前尚无实验证据表明互联网会干扰我们的专注力。
instance.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

instance.sentenceEn: Your father may never remember birthdays because your mother does, for instance .
instance.translationZh: 例如，你的父亲可能永远记不住家人的生日，因为你母亲会记住。
instance.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

instance.sentenceEn: You make further inferences, for instance , about how the text may be significant to you, or about its validity – inferences that form the basis of a personal response for which the author will inevitably be far less responsible.
instance.translationZh: 你会进一步进行推断，例如，推断文本对你可能具有何种意义，或推断其有效性——这些推断构成了个人回应的基础，而作者对此个人回应的责任无疑要小得多。

incentive.sentenceEn: These agencies and other government bodies should dramatically improve incentives to keep our current shows and attract new productions to Los Angeles.
incentive.translationZh: 这些机构和其他政府部门应当大幅加大激励力度，以留住现有的影视节目并吸引新作品来到洛杉矶。
incentive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

incentive.sentenceEn: Other regions in the United States, Canada and Europe have steadily increased incentives to attract TV shows and movies, leaving California in the dust.
incentive.translationZh: 美国其他地区、加拿大以及欧洲都在稳步加大力度，通过激励措施吸引影视剧组入驻，这使得加利福尼亚州望尘莫及。
incentive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

incentive.sentenceEn: That timing could reward high-quality service and give workers an incentive to provide it.
incentive.translationZh: 这种时间安排能够奖励高质量服务，并激励员工提供优质服务。
incentive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

incentive.sentenceEn: Coming at a time of fresh incentives from the UK government for landowners to grow more trees, the trade body says these don't go far enough and fail to promote the benefits of planting them to boost timber supplies.
incentive.translationZh: 尽管英国政府最近出台了鼓励土地所有者多种树的新激励措施，但该行业机构表示，这些措施力度不够，未能充分宣传植树对增加木材供应的益处。
incentive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

incentive.sentenceEn: From the early days of broadband, advocates for consumers and web-based companies worried that the cable and phone companies selling broadband connections had the power and incentive to favor affiliated websites over their rivals'.
incentive.translationZh: 从宽带发展初期开始，消费者权益倡导者和网络公司就担心，提供宽带连接服务的有线电视和电话公司有能力且有动机偏袒关联网站，而歧视其竞争对手的网站。
incentive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

incentive.sentenceEn: On this, students' and colleges' incentives seem to be aligned.
incentive.translationZh: 在这一点上，学生和大学的动机似乎是一致的。
incentive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第3句

institute.sentenceEn: An annual survey by the Chartered Institute of Public Finance and Accountancy puts it at nearly 800 across the UK; official statistics held by the Arts Council record 230 in England.
institute.translationZh: 英国公共财政与会计学会的一项年度调查显示，全英此类机构数量接近 800 家；而英格兰艺术委员会的官方统计数据记录，在英格兰仅有 230 家。
institute.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

institute.sentenceEn: "There's not a National Institute of Older Driver Studies," she said.
institute.translationZh: 她说：“目前还没有专门针对老年驾驶员研究的国家机构。”
institute.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

institute.sentenceEn: And surfing the web exercised the brain more than reading did among computer-savvy older adults in a 2008 study involving 24 participants at the Semel Institute for Neuroscience and Human Behavior at the University of California, Los Angeles.
institute.translationZh: 2008年，加州大学洛杉矶分校塞梅尔神经科学与人类行为研究所开展了一项涉及24名参与者的研究，结果显示，在精通电脑的老年人中，上网冲浪比阅读更能锻炼大脑。
institute.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

institute.sentenceEn: More than half a century ago, the Massachusetts Institute of Technology opened its Center for Advanced Visual Studies (CAVS) to explore the role of technology in culture.
institute.translationZh: 半个多世纪前，麻省理工学院成立了高级视觉研究中心（CAVS），旨在探索科技在文化中的作用。
institute.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

institute.sentenceEn: The only previous study analyzing causality, based on an area in Mexico that had instituted CCTs, supported the traditional view.
institute.translationZh: 此前唯一一项分析因果关系的研究基于墨西哥一个已实施有条件现金转移支付计划的地区，其结果支持了这一传统观点。
institute.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

institute.sentenceEn: According to the Canadian Institute for Health Information, prescription drug costs have risen since 1997 at twice the rate of overall health-care spending. Part of the increase comes from drugs being used to replace other kinds of treatments. Part of it arises from new drugs costing more than older kinds. Part of it is higher prices.
institute.translationZh: 加拿大卫生信息研究所的数据显示，自1997年以来，处方药费用的增长率是整体医疗支出增长率的两倍。这一增长部分源于药物正在替代其他类型的治疗方法，部分源于新药比旧药更昂贵，还有部分原因是药价上涨。
institute.paperLabel: 考研英语 2005 英语（未分卷）

identity.sentenceEn: The clothes we choose can reflect our personality, mood, and identity .
identity.translationZh: 我们选择的着装可以反映我们的个性、心情和身份。
identity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

identity.sentenceEn: Today the rapid growth of artificial intelligence (AI) raises fundamental questions: "What is intelligence, identity , or consciousness? What makes humans humans?"
identity.translationZh: 如今，人工智能（AI）的迅猛发展引发了一些根本性问题：“何为智能、身份或意识？是什么让人类成为人类？”
identity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

identity.sentenceEn: Facebook promised the European commission then that it would not link phone numbers to Facebook identities , but it broke the promise almost as soon as the deal went through.
identity.translationZh: 当时，脸书向欧盟委员会承诺不会将电话号码与脸书身份信息相关联，但这笔交易刚一完成，它就违背了这一承诺。
identity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

identity.sentenceEn: With or without permission, they straddle laws, jurisdictions and identities with ease.
identity.translationZh: 无论是否获得许可，他们都能轻松跨越法律、司法管辖区域和身份的界限。
identity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

identity.sentenceEn: It is not that pink is intrinsically bad, but it is such a tiny slice of the rainbow and, though it may celebrate girlhood in one way, it also repeatedly and firmly fuses girls' identity to appearance.
identity.translationZh: 这并非说粉色本身有什么不好，而是它仅仅是彩虹光谱中的一小部分。尽管粉色在某种程度上彰显了少女特质，但它也一再将女孩的身份与外表牢牢地绑定在一起。
identity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

identity.sentenceEn: The idea is to create a federation of private online identity systems.
identity.translationZh: 这一构想旨在创建一个私营在线身份系统联盟。
identity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

immediate.sentenceEn: A more immediate response is to broaden our digital imaginations to conceive of AI technologies that don't simply replace jobs but expand opportunities in the sectors that different parts of the country care most about, like health care, education, and manufacturing.
immediate.translationZh: 一个更直接的应对措施是拓宽我们的数字想象力，以构想那些不只是简单取代工作岗位，而是能在全国不同地区最关注的行业（如医疗保健、教育和制造业）中拓展机会的人工智能技术。
immediate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第1句

immediate.sentenceEn: Kids tend to get stuck in the features and the immediate benefits to them personally, Norris said.
immediate.translationZh: 诺里斯说，孩子们往往只关注房子的特色以及这些特色给自己带来的即时利益。
immediate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第13段，第1句

immediate.sentenceEn: The most immediate changes will be observed in skill level, strength and inches lost.
immediate.translationZh: 最立即可见的变化将体现在技能水平、力量和腰围尺寸的减小上。
immediate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

immediate.sentenceEn: Perhaps willfully, it may be easier to think about such lengthy timescales than about the more immediate future.
immediate.translationZh: 或许是有意为之，思考如此漫长的时间跨度反而比思考不久的将来更容易。
immediate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

immediate.sentenceEn: Because electronic payments are immediate , they eliminate the float for the consumer.
immediate.translationZh: 由于电子支付是即时到账的，这就消除了消费者的'浮动期'。
immediate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

immediate.sentenceEn: Our immediate future is hard to conceive.
immediate.translationZh: 我们近期的未来难以想象。

insect.sentenceEn: " Insects that today are a minor problem may become a major problem if they can produce three or four generations in a year," says forest ecologist John Stanturf.
insect.translationZh: 森林生态学家约翰·斯坦特夫表示：“如果某些昆虫一年能繁殖三到四代，那么如今只是小麻烦的它们，未来可能会演变成大问题。”
insect.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

insect.sentenceEn: Climate change is also expected to alter relationships between trees, insects , diseases and other forest species.
insect.translationZh: 预计气候变化还将改变树木、昆虫、疾病以及其他森林物种之间的关系。
insect.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

insect.sentenceEn: Peters likes to photograph butterflies in a landscape, celebrating the beauty of their surroundings as well as the insects themselves.
insect.translationZh: 彼得斯喜欢在风景中拍摄蝴蝶，既赞美昆虫本身的美丽，也颂扬它们周围环境的美好。

insect.sentenceEn: It's incredibly difficult to get that close to a skittish, sun-warmed insect .
insect.translationZh: 要如此靠近一只易受惊且被阳光晒暖的昆虫，难度极大。

insect.sentenceEn: Butterflies may not pollinate as many plants as wild bees and hoverflies, but because British butterflies are the best-studied group of insects in the world, they are an extremely useful indicator of the wider declines in flying insects .
insect.translationZh: 蝴蝶可能不像野生蜜蜂和食蚜蝇那样为那么多植物授粉，但由于英国蝴蝶是世界上研究最深入的昆虫群体，它们是反映飞行昆虫广泛减少的极其有用的指标。

insect.sentenceEn: Unlike some photographers, who "cheat" by keeping insects in a fridge to slow them down, Peters refuses to tamper with wild butterflies.
insect.translationZh: 有些摄影师会把昆虫放进冰箱使其行动迟缓来"作弊"，而彼得斯则拒绝以这种方式干扰野生蝴蝶。

intellect.sentenceEn: And perhaps faintly, they hint that people should look to intangible qualities like character and intellect rather than dieting their way to size zero or wasp-waist physiques.
intellect.translationZh: 或许这些举措还隐晦地暗示，人们应当注重性格和智力等无形品质，而非通过节食追求零号身材或蜂腰体型。
intellect.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

intellect.sentenceEn: Facebook, therefore, is a self-enhancer's paradise, where people can share only the most flattering photos, the cream of their wit, style, beauty, intellect and lifestyles.
intellect.translationZh: 因此，脸书成了自我美化者的天堂——人们可以在这里只分享自己最上镜的照片，以及自己的智慧、品味、美貌、才智和生活方式中最精华的部分。
intellect.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

intellect.sentenceEn: Darwin was convinced that the loss of these tastes was not only a loss of happiness, but might possibly be injurious to the intellect , and more probably to the moral character.
intellect.translationZh: 达尔文深信，失去这些爱好不仅意味着失去快乐，还可能对智力造成损害，更有可能伤及道德品格。
intellect.paperLabel: 考研英语 2008 英语（未分卷）
intellect.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

intellect.sentenceEn: But not all parts of the brain are equally involved; the limbic system (the "emotional brain") is especially active, while the prefrontal cortex (the center of intellect and reasoning) is relatively quiet.
intellect.translationZh: 但并非大脑的所有部分都同等程度地参与其中；边缘系统（即“情绪大脑”）异常活跃，而前额叶皮层（即智力与推理中心）则相对平静。
intellect.paperLabel: 考研英语 2005 英语（未分卷）
intellect.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

intellect.sentenceEn: Intellect is the critical, creative, and contemplative side of the mind.
intellect.translationZh: 才智是心智中批判性、创造性和沉思性的一面。
intellect.paperLabel: 考研英语 2004 英语（未分卷）
intellect.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

intellect.sentenceEn: What does the author think of intellect ?
intellect.paperLabel: 考研英语 2004 英语（未分卷）

implication.sentenceEn: For businesses, the implications are worrying.
implication.translationZh: 对于企业而言，其影响令人担忧。
implication.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

implication.sentenceEn: The implication is that Millennials prefer news from the White House to be filtered through other sources, not a president's social media platform.
implication.translationZh: 这意味着千禧一代更希望白宫新闻通过其他渠道过滤后发布，而非总统的社交媒体平台。
implication.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

implication.sentenceEn: Enough of the implications are discernable, even obvious, so that the justices can and should provide updated guidelines to police, lawyers and defendants.
implication.translationZh: 新技术的影响已有足够多是清晰可见、甚至显而易见的，因此法官们能够而且应当为警方、律师和被告提供更新后的指导方针。
implication.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

implication.sentenceEn: It is hard, the state argues, for judges to assess the implications of new and rapidly changing technologies.
implication.translationZh: 该州辩称，法官难以评估日新月异的新技术所带来的影响。
implication.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

implication.sentenceEn: But if the district is essentially giving a pass to students who do not do their homework because of complicated family lives, it is going riskily close to the implication that standards need to be lowered for poor children.
implication.translationZh: 但是，如果学区实质上是在给那些因家庭情况复杂而不做作业的学生开绿灯，这就危险地接近暗示需要为贫困儿童降低标准。
implication.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

implication.sentenceEn: In the ever-changing 21st century, even the word "habit" carries a negative implication .
implication.translationZh: 在日新月异的21世纪，连“习惯”一词都带上了负面含义。
implication.paperLabel: 考研英语 2009 英语（未分卷）
implication.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

inequality.sentenceEn: In a recent interview, Coyle said she fears that tech's inequality problem could be a roadblock to deploying AI.
inequality.translationZh: 在最近的一次采访中，科伊尔表示，她担心科技领域的不平等问题可能会成为人工智能部署的障碍。
inequality.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

inequality.sentenceEn: Called conditional cash transfers or CCTs, these social assistance programs are designed to reduce inequality and break the cycle of poverty.
inequality.translationZh: 这类社会救助项目被称为有条件现金转移支付(CCTs)，旨在减少不平等现象并打破贫困循环。
inequality.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

inequality.sentenceEn: Jealousy and anger, for example, may have evolved to alert us to important inequalities .
inequality.translationZh: 例如，嫉妒和愤怒可能已经进化为提醒我们注意重要的不平等现象。
inequality.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

inequality.sentenceEn: Taxes on low-wage labor need to be cut, and wage subsidies such as the earned income tax credit should be expanded: This would boost incomes, encourage work, reward companies for job creation, and reduce inequality .
inequality.translationZh: 需要削减对低薪劳动力的税收，并扩大诸如劳动所得税收抵免等工资补贴：这将提高收入水平，鼓励就业，奖励创造就业岗位的企业，并减少不平等现象。
inequality.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

inequality.sentenceEn: Some imagine that the coming work-free world will be defined by inequality : A few wealthy people will own all the capital, and the masses will struggle in an impoverished wasteland.
inequality.translationZh: 一些人想象，即将到来的无工作世界将以不平等为特征：少数富人将拥有所有资本，而大众将在贫困的荒原上挣扎。
inequality.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

inequality.sentenceEn: Marriage break-up stems from sex inequalities .
inequality.translationZh: 婚姻破裂源于性别不平等。

inflation.sentenceEn: This year's rise, an average of 2.7 per cent, may be a fraction lower than last year's, but it is still well above the official Consumer Price Index (CPI) measure of inflation .
inflation.translationZh: 今年的票价平均上涨2.7%，虽比去年略低，但仍远高于官方消费者价格指数（CPI）衡量的通胀水平。
inflation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

inflation.sentenceEn: A report last year pointed out that the costs both of subscriptions and of these "article preparation costs" had been steadily rising at a rate above inflation .
inflation.translationZh: 去年的一份报告指出，订阅费用和这些“文章处理费”的成本一直在以高于通胀的速度稳步上涨。
inflation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第4句

inflation.sentenceEn: Grade inflation – the gradual increase in average GPAs (grade-point averages) over the past few decades – is often considered a product of a consumer era in higher education, in which students are treated like customers to be pleased.
inflation.translationZh: 成绩膨胀——即过去几十年来平均绩点（GPA）的逐渐上升——通常被认为是高等教育进入消费时代的产物。在这个时代，学生被当作需要取悦的顾客来对待。
inflation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

inflation.sentenceEn: During the decade before the economic crisis, spending on legal services in America grew twice as fast as inflation .
inflation.translationZh: 在经济危机爆发前的十年间，美国法律服务支出的增长速度是通货膨胀的两倍。
inflation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

inflation.sentenceEn: Both previous shocks resulted in double-digit inflation and global economic decline.
inflation.translationZh: 这两次石油危机都导致了两位数的通货膨胀率和全球经济衰退。
inflation.paperLabel: 考研英语 2002 英语（未分卷）
inflation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

inflation.sentenceEn: What is commonly regarded as the cause of grade inflation ?
inflation.translationZh: 通常认为成绩膨胀的原因是什么？

infant.sentenceEn: From life expectancy to cancer and infant mortality rates, we are lagging behind many of our peers.
infant.translationZh: 从预期寿命到癌症及婴儿死亡率，我们都落后于许多同类国家。
infant.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

infant.sentenceEn: An infant born to a hunter-gatherer society could have more than ten caregivers—this contrasts starkly to nursery settings in the UK where regulations call for a ratio of one carer to four children aged two to three.
infant.translationZh: 一个出生在狩猎采集社会的婴儿可能有十多位照料者——这与英国托儿所的情况形成鲜明对比，英国的规定要求2至3岁儿童的照料比例为1:4。
infant.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

infant.sentenceEn: It found that infants had an average of 14 alloparents a day by the time they were 18 weeks old and were passed between caregivers eight times an hour.
infant.translationZh: 该研究发现，18周大的婴儿平均每天有14位养育人，每小时会在不同照护者之间被传递8次。
infant.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

infant.sentenceEn: Kung children as young as four will help to look after younger ones and "baby-wearing", in which infants are carried in slings, is considered the norm.
infant.translationZh: 年仅四岁的昆族儿童就会帮忙照顾年幼的孩子，而“婴儿背带”——即用背带携带婴儿的做法——被视为常态。
infant.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

infant.sentenceEn: We know that a typical infant will instinctively gaze into its mother's eyes, and she will look back.
infant.translationZh: 我们知道，普通婴儿会本能地凝视母亲的眼睛，而母亲也会回以注视。
infant.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

infant.sentenceEn: Infants are wired to look at parents' faces to try to understand their world, and if those faces are blank and unresponsive – as they often are when absorbed in a device – it can be extremely disconcerting for the children.
infant.translationZh: 婴儿天生就会通过观察父母的面部表情来尝试理解他们的世界，如果这些表情变得茫然且毫无反应——就像父母沉浸在电子设备中时经常出现的那样——这会让孩子感到极度不安。
infant.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

integrate.sentenceEn: Their interests as stewards of the land need to be better integrated with those who have the money to support restoration.
integrate.translationZh: 他们作为土地管家的利益需要与那些拥有资金支持修复的人士的利益更好地结合起来。
integrate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第4句

integrate.sentenceEn: Yet, reluctance persists among other planners to integrate desire paths into formal plans, citing concerns about safety, environmental impact, or primarily, aesthetics.
integrate.translationZh: 然而，其他规划者仍然不愿意将这些"欲望路径"纳入正式规划中，他们提出的理由包括安全隐患、环境影响，或者最主要的是美观问题。
integrate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

integrate.sentenceEn: Another issue is that while climate change is well integrated into some subjects and at some ages—such as earth and space sciences in high schools—it is not as well represented in curricula for younger children and in subjects that are more widely taught, such as biology and chemistry.
integrate.translationZh: 另一个问题是，虽然气候变化已很好地融入某些学科和特定年龄段的教学中——例如高中的地球与空间科学——但在低龄儿童的课程以及生物、化学等开设更为普遍的学科中，气候变化的内容却未能得到同等程度的体现。
integrate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

integrate.sentenceEn: As many took on the duty of trying to integrate reasoning and scientific philosophies into the world, the Renaissance was over and it was time for a new era—the Age of Reason.
integrate.translationZh: 当许多人开始肩负起将理性思考与科学哲学融入世界的使命时，文艺复兴时代宣告结束，一个全新的时代——理性时代，已然到来。
integrate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

integrate.sentenceEn: Generally there was a belief that the new nations should be sovereign and independent states, large enough to be economically viable and integrated by a common set of laws.
integrate.translationZh: 普遍认为，新国家应当是主权独立的国家，其规模应足以维持经济稳定运行，并通过一套共同的法律实现国家统一。
integrate.paperLabel: 考研英语 2007 英语（未分卷）
integrate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

integrate.sentenceEn: The idea is to force social scientists to integrate their work with other categories, including health and demographic change; food security; marine research and the bio-economy; clean, efficient energy; and inclusive, innovative and secure societies.
integrate.translationZh: 其目的是促使社会科学家将其研究工作与其他领域相结合，包括健康与人口变化、粮食安全、海洋研究与生物经济、清洁高效能源以及包容、创新和安全的社会。

interested.sentenceEn: I loved the man from the Thirties research who found that wireless suddenly offered "a lot of variety…things I thought I'd never be interested in…ice hockey perhaps".
interested.translationZh: 我很喜欢那项三十年代研究中的那位受访者，他发现广播突然间提供了“极其丰富的内容……那些我原以为自己永远不会感兴趣的东西……比如冰球”。
interested.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

interested.sentenceEn: Psychologists have been interested in this question for decades, not least because people's widespread reluctance to ask for help has led to some high-profile failures.
interested.translationZh: 心理学家对这个问题的研究已有数十年之久，尤其是因为人们普遍不愿寻求帮助，这已导致了一些备受瞩目的失败案例。
interested.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

interested.sentenceEn: They aren't interested in taking any chances.
interested.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

interested.sentenceEn: Millennials may not be that interested in taking their place.
interested.translationZh: 千禧一代可能对接替他们的岗位不太感兴趣。
interested.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

interested.sentenceEn: Giving more children this training could increase the number of people interested in the field and help fill the jobs gap, Cortina said.
interested.translationZh: 科尔蒂纳说，让更多孩子接受这种培训可能会增加对该领域感兴趣的人数，并有助于填补就业缺口。
interested.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

interested.sentenceEn: People are more interested in unaffordable garments.
interested.translationZh: 人们对买不起的服装更感兴趣。

increased.sentenceEn: Long gaps there saw increased connection.
increased.translationZh: 这些长时间的间隔反而促进了更强的联系。
increased.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

increased.sentenceEn: That will likely take increased federal funding for research independent of the tech giants.
increased.translationZh: 这可能需要增加联邦资金，用于开展独立于科技巨头的研究。
increased.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

increased.sentenceEn: Now, with record-high home prices and historically low inventory, there's an increased urgency in such regulation, particularly among those who worry that developers will come in and buy up swaths of housing to flip for a fortune on the short-term rental market.
increased.translationZh: 如今，随着房价创下历史新高，而房屋库存量处于历史低位，此类监管的紧迫性愈发凸显，尤其是那些担心开发商会涌入市场、大量收购住房，然后在短租市场中转手牟取暴利的人们。
increased.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

increased.sentenceEn: "There may be costs associated with our increased reliance on the Internet, but I'd have to imagine that overall the benefits are going to outweigh those costs," observes psychology professor Benjamin Storm.
increased.translationZh: 心理学教授本杰明·斯托姆指出：“我们对互联网的依赖加深可能会带来一些代价，但我认为总体而言，其益处将超过这些代价。”
increased.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

increased.sentenceEn: "All this comes at an increased cost during a time when prices are already sky high. Inevitably, consumers will have to pay more," he says.
increased.translationZh: 他表示：“所有这些都将增加成本，而眼下各种价格已经高得离谱。消费者将不可避免地要支付更多费用。”
increased.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

increased.sentenceEn: I'm experiencing increased zeal for working out since I no longer carry the burden of a disappointing morning weigh-in.
increased.translationZh: 我对锻炼的热情日益高涨，因为我再也不用背负早晨称重结果令人失望的负担了。
increased.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

inspire.sentenceEn: Artifacts in museums have the power to inspire , and perhaps spark that need to learn and understand the nature of their creators.
inspire.translationZh: 博物馆中的文物具有启发人心的力量，或许还能激发人们去了解和理解其创造者的本质。
inspire.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第3句

inspire.sentenceEn: It inspired me to learn more about the culture that it represented.
inspire.translationZh: 它激发了我去更多地了解这件雕塑所代表的文化。
inspire.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

inspire.sentenceEn: The same curiosity to find what lies beyond the horizon that first brought early Polynesians to Hawaii's shores inspires astronomers today to explore the heavens.
inspire.translationZh: 正是这种探索地平线之外世界的好奇心，最初将早期波利尼西亚人带到了夏威夷海岸，如今也激励着天文学家去探索宇宙。
inspire.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

inspire.sentenceEn: The Parkrun phenomenon began with a dozen friends and has inspired 400 events in the UK and more abroad.
inspire.translationZh: 公园跑这一现象最初由十几位朋友发起，如今已在英国催生了400场活动，在国外的活动更多。
inspire.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

inspire.sentenceEn: Official retrospections continue as to why London 2012 failed to " inspire a generation."
inspire.translationZh: 官方仍在不断反思2012年伦敦奥运会为何未能'激励一代人'。
inspire.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第10句

interpret.sentenceEn: When you take things personally, you're interpreting these situations as saying something significant and negative about you as a person.
interpret.translationZh: 当你把事情看作是针对个人时，你实际上是将这些情况解读为对自己人格的重大否定。
interpret.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

interpret.sentenceEn: Or, two of your friends cancel your planned get-together at the pub and you interpret this as meaning they're bored of you.
interpret.translationZh: 或者，你的两个朋友取消了原本在酒吧的聚会，而你却将此解读为他们已经厌倦了你。
interpret.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

interpret.sentenceEn: Urban planners interpret desire paths as more than just convenient shortcuts; they offer valuable insights into the dynamics between planning and behaviour.
interpret.translationZh: 城市规划师认为， desire paths 不仅仅是便捷的捷径；它们还为理解规划与行为之间的动态关系提供了宝贵见解。
interpret.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

interpret.sentenceEn: Competition law as presently interpreted deals with financial disadvantage to consumers and this is not obvious when the users of these services don't pay for them.
interpret.translationZh: 当前所阐释的竞争法主要处理对消费者造成的经济损害问题，然而当这些服务的用户无需付费使用时，这种损害就显得不那么明显了。
interpret.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第6句

interpret.sentenceEn: One could interpret much of the work of Beethoven by saying that suffering is inevitable, but the courage to fight it renders life worth living.
interpret.translationZh: 我们可以这样解读贝多芬的大部分作品：苦难是不可避免的，但与之抗争的勇气使生命变得有价值。
interpret.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第4句

interpret.sentenceEn: We must speed up our literature too, if we want to interpret modern stress.
interpret.translationZh: 若想诠释现代生活的压力，我们的文学也必须加快节奏。
interpret.paperLabel: 考研英语 2000 英语（未分卷）
interpret.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

interpretation.sentenceEn: When you find yourself taking a situation personally, try to think of other interpretations that are less focused on you — especially in the sense of saying anything deep or fundamental about you.
interpretation.translationZh: 当你发现自己对某种情况过于敏感、认为是在针对自己时，试着去寻找其他不那么以你为中心的解释——特别是要意识到，这件事并不代表对你个人深度或本质上的定性。
interpretation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

interpretation.sentenceEn: It can be hard for scientists to make the case because our work is complex, often takes place behind closed doors and does not always lend itself to easy interpretation or explanation.
interpretation.translationZh: 科学家们往往难以阐明自己的工作价值，因为我们的研究复杂难懂，常常在闭门情况下进行，而且并非总能轻易解释或说明。
interpretation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

interpretation.sentenceEn: This doesn't, however, make interpretation merely relative or even pointless.
interpretation.translationZh: 然而，这并不意味着解读仅仅是相对的，甚至是毫无意义的。
interpretation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

interpretation.sentenceEn: Today, professors routinely treat the progressive interpretation of history and progressive public policy as the proper subject of study while portraying conservative or classical liberal ideas – such as free markets and self-reliance – as falling outside the boundaries of routine, and sometimes legitimate, intellectual investigation.
interpretation.translationZh: 如今，教授们通常将对历史的进步主义解读和进步主义公共政策视为恰当的研究课题，同时将保守派或古典自由主义思想——如自由市场和自力更生——描绘成超出常规研究范畴，有时甚至是超出正当学术探讨界限的内容。
interpretation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

interpretation.sentenceEn: Evans's interpretations of these engravings eventually led him to find the Minoan palace at Knossos (Knosós), on the island of Crete, in 1900.
interpretation.translationZh: 埃文斯对这些雕刻品的解读最终引导他于1900年在克里特岛发现了克诺索斯（Knosós）的米诺斯宫殿。

interpretation.sentenceEn: Factors such as the place and period in which we are reading, our gender, ethnicity, age and social class will encourage us towards certain interpretations but at the same time obscure or even close off others.
interpretation.translationZh: 诸如阅读的地点和时期、我们的性别、种族、年龄和社会阶层等因素，会促使我们倾向于某些解读，同时却掩盖甚至排除了其他可能的理解方式。

imagination.translationZh: 在这一年，尽情释放你的想象力。

imagination.sentenceEn: Our imagination — remember that? — is rekindled.
imagination.translationZh: 我们的想象力——还记得吗？——被重新点燃了。

imagination.sentenceEn: A more immediate response is to broaden our digital imaginations to conceive of AI technologies that don't simply replace jobs but expand opportunities in the sectors that different parts of the country care most about, like health care, education, and manufacturing.
imagination.translationZh: 一个更直接的应对措施是拓宽我们的数字想象力，以构想那些不只是简单取代工作岗位，而是能在全国不同地区最关注的行业（如医疗保健、教育和制造业）中拓展机会的人工智能技术。
imagination.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第1句

imagination.sentenceEn: In the popular imagination , of course, guilt still gets a bad rap.
imagination.translationZh: 当然，在大众的印象中，内疚仍然名声不佳。
imagination.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

imagination.sentenceEn: I do completely agree that fears are just the product of our luxuriant imagination .
imagination.translationZh: 我完全同意，恐惧不过是我们丰富想象力的产物。
imagination.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第5句

imagination.sentenceEn: In our rapidly changing economy, we more than ever need people in the workplace who can take initiative and exercise their imagination "to respond to unexpected events".
imagination.translationZh: 在我们瞬息万变的经济环境中，我们比以往任何时候都更需要那些在工作场合能够主动采取行动并发挥想象力以应对突发事件的人才。
imagination.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

import.sentenceEn: The forestry and wood trade body has called for urgent action to reduce the country's reliance on timber imports and provide a stable supply of wood for future generations.
import.translationZh: 这家林业和木材行业机构呼吁采取紧急行动，以减少该国对木材进口的依赖，并为子孙后代提供稳定的木材供应。
import.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

import.sentenceEn: Brexit is seen by some as an opportunity to reverse a recent trend towards the UK importing food.
import.translationZh: 一些人将英国脱欧视为扭转英国近期食品进口趋势的契机。
import.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

import.sentenceEn: From 1998 to 2000, 14.5 percent of the fruit Americans consumed was imported .
import.translationZh: 1998年至2000年间，美国人消费的水果中有14.5%是进口的。
import.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第3句

import.sentenceEn: Little more than a decade later, the share of imports was 25.8 percent.
import.translationZh: 仅十多年后，进口水果的份额就达到了25.8%。
import.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第4句

import.sentenceEn: In effect, the U.S. can import food or it can import the workers who pick it.
import.translationZh: 实际上，美国要么进口食品，要么进口采摘食品的工人。
import.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第1句

import.sentenceEn: The OECD estimates in its latest Economic Outlook that, if oil prices averaged $22 a barrel for a full year, compared with $13 in 1998, this would increase the oil import bill in rich economies by only 0.25-0.5% of GDP.
import.translationZh: 经合组织在其最新的《经济展望》中估计，如果石油价格全年平均达到每桶22美元，与1998年的13美元相比，这将使富裕经济体的石油进口账单仅增加国内生产总值的0.25%至0.5%。

import.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第5句

inadequate.sentenceEn: There are a lot of tasks to be done, there are inadequate rewards for most of them.
inadequate.translationZh: 家里有太多活儿要干，而其中大多数都得不到足够的回报。
inadequate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

inadequate.paperLabel: 考研英语 2005 英语（未分卷）
inadequate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

inadequate.sentenceEn: the research on radio used to be inadequate .
inadequate.translationZh: 过去对无线电的研究并不充分。

indicator.sentenceEn: Butterflies may not pollinate as many plants as wild bees and hoverflies, but because British butterflies are the best-studied group of insects in the world, they are an extremely useful indicator of the wider declines in flying insects.
indicator.translationZh: 蝴蝶可能不像野生蜜蜂和食蚜蝇那样为那么多植物授粉，但由于英国蝴蝶是世界上研究最深入的昆虫群体，它们是反映飞行昆虫广泛减少的极其有用的指标。

indicator.sentenceEn: Yes, there has been a budding economic recovery since the 2008 global crash, but in key indicators in areas such as health and education, major economies have continued to decline.
indicator.translationZh: 诚然，自2008年全球金融危机以来，经济已出现初步复苏迹象，但在医疗和教育等关键领域的核心指标上，主要经济体却持续下滑。
indicator.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

indicator.sentenceEn: To find out, the researchers controlled for various factors that might make firms more likely to invest – like size, industry, and sales – and for indicators that a place was desirable to live in, like growth in wages or population.
indicator.translationZh: 为了找出答案，研究人员控制了可能促使企业增加投资的各种因素——如企业规模、行业和销售额——以及衡量一个地方宜居性的指标，如工资增长或人口增长。
indicator.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

indicator.sentenceEn: Likewise, among the elderly, being somewhat overweight is often an indicator of good health.
indicator.translationZh: 同样，在老年人中，体重略超通常是健康状况良好的标志。
indicator.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第5句

indicator.sentenceEn: "I'm a good economic indicator ," she says.
indicator.translationZh: 她说：“我就是个很好的经济晴雨表。”

indicator.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第5句

inevitably.sentenceEn: "All this comes at an increased cost during a time when prices are already sky high. Inevitably , consumers will have to pay more," he says.
inevitably.translationZh: 他表示：“所有这些都将增加成本，而眼下各种价格已经高得离谱。消费者将不可避免地要支付更多费用。”
inevitably.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

inevitably.sentenceEn: The moves are the most significant change to building regulations in years, and industry experts say they will inevitably lead to higher prices at a time when a shortage of materials and high labour costs are already driving up bills.
inevitably.translationZh: 这些举措是近年来建筑法规最重大的变革，行业专家表示，在目前材料短缺和劳动力成本高企已在推高建筑费用的情况下，新规将不可避免地导致价格进一步上涨。
inevitably.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

inevitably.sentenceEn: Requiring companies to make gender the primary qualification for board membership will inevitably lead to less experienced private sector boards.
inevitably.translationZh: 要求公司将性别作为董事会成员的首要任职资格，将不可避免地导致私营部门董事会成员的经验水平下降。
inevitably.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第1句

inevitably.sentenceEn: That's because they inevitably put the costs of cleaning the air on to individual drivers—who must pay fees or buy better vehicles—rather than on to the car manufacturers whose cheating is the real cause of our toxic pollution.
inevitably.translationZh: 这是因为这些措施不可避免地将净化空气的成本转嫁给了个体司机——他们必须支付费用或购买更环保的车辆——而非汽车制造商，而正是这些制造商的作弊行为才是造成我们有毒污染的真正原因。
inevitably.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

inevitably.sentenceEn: Such background material inevitably reflects who we are.
inevitably.translationZh: 这类背景知识不可避免地反映了我们是谁。
inevitably.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

inevitably.sentenceEn: You make further inferences, for instance, about how the text may be significant to you, or about its validity – inferences that form the basis of a personal response for which the author will inevitably be far less responsible.
inevitably.translationZh: 你会进一步进行推断，例如，推断文本对你可能具有何种意义，或推断其有效性——这些推断构成了个人回应的基础，而作者对此个人回应的责任无疑要小得多。

innovative.sentenceEn: To gain buy-in on an innovative , new idea, follow these steps:
innovative.translationZh: 要让人们接受一个创新的新想法，请遵循以下步骤：
innovative.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第7句

innovative.sentenceEn: Everyone wants to be that person—the one who looks at the same information as everyone else, but who sees a fresh, innovative solution.
innovative.translationZh: 每个人都想成为那样的人——与其他人看到相同的信息，却能想出全新且富有创意的解决方案。
innovative.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

innovative.sentenceEn: Things changed, however, when an innovative project-marketing manager came aboard, created a growth team and sparked the kind of fresh perspective they needed.
innovative.translationZh: 然而，当一位富有创新精神的项目营销经理加入公司，组建了增长团队，并带来了他们所需的全新视角后，情况发生了改变。
innovative.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

innovative.sentenceEn: To Microsoft's critics, the fates of Wunderlist and Sunrise are examples of a remorseless drive by Big Tech to chew up any innovative companies that lie in their path.
innovative.translationZh: 在微软的批评者看来，Wunderlist和Sunrise的命运是科技巨头无情打压创新企业的例证——它们会吞噬任何阻碍其发展道路的创新公司。
innovative.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

innovative.sentenceEn: But brain researchers have discovered that when we consciously develop new habits, we create parallel paths, and even entirely new brain cells, that can jump our trains of thought onto new, innovative tracks.
innovative.translationZh: 但大脑研究人员发现，当我们有意识地培养新习惯时，我们会创建平行路径，甚至生成全新的脑细胞，这些能让我们的思维列车转换到新的创新轨道上。
innovative.paperLabel: 考研英语 2009 英语（未分卷）
innovative.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

innovative.sentenceEn: The idea is to force social scientists to integrate their work with other categories, including health and demographic change; food security; marine research and the bio-economy; clean, efficient energy; and inclusive, innovative and secure societies.
innovative.translationZh: 其目的是促使社会科学家将其研究工作与其他领域相结合，包括健康与人口变化、粮食安全、海洋研究与生物经济、清洁高效能源以及包容、创新和安全的社会。

interact.sentenceEn: Algorithms used to simulate human interactions are creating many of these concerns, especially as no-one is quite sure what the outcomes of using AI to interact with customers will be.
interact.translationZh: 用于模拟人际互动的算法引发了诸多此类担忧，尤其是因为没有人能完全确定使用人工智能与客户互动会产生何种结果。
interact.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

interact.sentenceEn: Beginning in 2006, some scientists have argued that plants possess neuron-like cells that interact with hormones and neurotransmitters, forming "a plant nervous system, analogous to that in animals," said lead study author Lincoln Taiz.
interact.translationZh: 研究主要作者林肯·泰兹表示，自2006年起，一些科学家就认为植物拥有类神经元细胞，这些细胞能与激素和神经递质相互作用，形成"类似于动物神经系统的植物神经系统"。
interact.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

interact.sentenceEn: While that may well be true, researchers have also recently found that interacting with strangers actually brings a boost in mood and feelings of belonging that we didn't expect.
interact.translationZh: 虽然这很可能是事实，但研究人员最近还发现，与陌生人互动实际上能带来我们未曾预料到的情绪提升和归属感增强。
interact.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

interact.sentenceEn: In it, a mother is asked to interact with her child in a normal way before putting on a blank expression and not giving them any visual social feedback: The child becomes increasingly distressed as she tries to capture her mother's attention.
interact.translationZh: 在这个实验中，母亲被要求先以正常方式与孩子互动，然后摆出毫无表情的面孔，不给孩子任何视觉社交反馈：孩子在试图吸引母亲注意时会变得越来越苦恼。
interact.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

interact.sentenceEn: It's a sad reality – our desire to avoid interacting with other human beings – because there's much to be gained from talking to the stranger standing by you.
interact.translationZh: 这是一个令人悲哀的现实——我们渴望避免与他人互动——因为与身边的陌生人交谈其实能带来诸多收获。
interact.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

interact.sentenceEn: Firms are now studying how genes interact , looking for correlations that might be used to determine the causes of disease or predict a drug's efficacy.
interact.translationZh: 各公司目前正在研究基因间的相互作用，寻找可用于确定疾病成因或预测药物疗效的关联模式。
interact.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

investigation.sentenceEn: In 2021, Flo Health faced a Federal Trade Commission (FTC) investigation .
investigation.translationZh: 2021年，Flo Health公司面临美国联邦贸易委员会（FTC）的调查。
investigation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

investigation.sentenceEn: Yet the FCC also ended the investigations of broadband providers that imposed data caps on their rivals' streaming services but not their own.
investigation.translationZh: 然而，联邦通信委员会也终止了对宽带服务商的调查，这些服务商对竞争对手的流媒体服务设置了数据上限，却对自家服务网开一面。
investigation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

investigation.sentenceEn: But it has already sparked significant controversy, with the United States trade representative opening an investigation into whether the tax discriminates against American companies, which in turn could lead to trade sanctions against France.
investigation.translationZh: 但该法案已引发重大争议，美国贸易代表已着手调查这项税收是否歧视美国企业，这反过来可能导致美国对法国实施贸易制裁。
investigation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

investigation.sentenceEn: Starting next year, any guaranteed bonus of top executives could be delayed 10 years if their banks are under investigation for wrongdoing.
investigation.translationZh: 从明年开始，若银行因不当行为正在接受调查，高管的任何保障性奖金都可能被推迟10年发放。
investigation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

investigation.sentenceEn: It argues that since prosecutors do not consume a company's products as part of their investigations , they could be influenced only by the halo effect.
investigation.translationZh: 该研究认为，由于检察官在调查过程中不会消费涉案公司的产品，因此他们只会受到“光环效应”的影响。
investigation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

investigation.sentenceEn: It is under the FCC's investigation .
investigation.translationZh: 它正在联邦通信委员会的调查之下。

item.sentenceEn: The foreign countries have no right to hold back returning the items .
item.translationZh: 外国无权拒绝归还这些物品。

item.sentenceEn: Those pieces included small beds of roses and other items as well as a few dozen "nature carpets"—large rectangles decorated with foam pumpkins, cabbages, and watermelons.
item.translationZh: 这些作品包括玫瑰花丛等小型物件，以及几十块“自然地毯”——这些大型矩形作品装饰着泡沫制成的南瓜、卷心菜和西瓜。

item.sentenceEn: Try to slot it in as a to-do list item and you'll manage only goal-focused reading – useful, sometimes, but not the most fulfilling kind.
item.translationZh: 如果你试图把阅读列为待办事项中的一项，那么你只能实现以目标为导向的阅读——这种阅读有时确实有用，但并非最能充实心灵的那种。
item.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

item.sentenceEn: Americans, she finds, buy roughly 20 billion garments a year – about 64 items per person – and no matter how much they give away, this excess leads to waste.
item.translationZh: 她发现，美国人每年购买约200亿件服装——平均每人约64件——无论他们捐赠多少，这种过度消费都会造成浪费。
