impression.sentenceEn: We're fairly good at judging people based on first impressions , thin slices of experience ranging from a glimpse of a photo to five-minute interaction, and deliberation can be not only extraneous but intrusive.
impression.translationZh: 我们相当擅长根据第一印象来判断他人——这种快速的经验片段可以是匆匆一瞥的照片，也可以是五分钟的互动——而深思熟虑不仅多余，甚至会造成干扰。
impression.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

impression.sentenceEn: Ambady suspected that deliberation focused them on vivid but misleading cues, such as certain gestures or utterances, rather than letting the complex interplay of subtle signals form a holistic impression .
impression.translationZh: 安巴迪猜测，深思熟虑使参与者将注意力集中在那些鲜明但具有误导性的线索上，比如某些手势或话语，而未能让微妙信号间的复杂相互作用形成一个整体印象。
impression.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

impression.sentenceEn: This is especially true in first impressions .
impression.translationZh: 这一点在第一印象中尤为重要。
impression.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

impression.sentenceEn: History and news become confused, and one's impressions tend to be a mixture of skepticism and optimism.
impression.translationZh: 历史与新闻变得混淆不清，人们的印象往往是怀疑与乐观交织的复杂感受。
impression.paperLabel: 考研英语 2005 英语（未分卷）
impression.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

impression.sentenceEn: In talking to some scientists, particularly younger ones, you might gather the impression that they find the "scientific method" a substitute for imaginative thought.
impression.translationZh: 在与一些科学家，尤其是年轻科学家交谈时，你可能会产生这样一种印象：他们认为“科学方法”可以替代富有想象力的思考。
impression.paperLabel: 考研英语 1999 英语（未分卷）
impression.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

impression.sentenceEn: After you have clearly and adequately developed the body of your paper, pay particular attention to the introductory and concluding paragraphs. It's probably best to write the introduction last, after you know precisely what you are introducing. Concluding paragraphs demand equal attention because they leave the reader with a final impression .
impression.translationZh: 在清晰且充分地完成论文主体部分后，要特别注意引言和结论段落。最好是在确切知道自己要引入什么内容之后再写引言，也就是把引言留到最后写。结论段落同样需要重点打磨，因为它们会给读者留下最终印象。
impression.paperLabel: 考研英语 2008 英语（未分卷）

increasing.sentenceEn: But after the war, great social and political changes arising out of the successful war against Fascism created a growing demand in European and American economies for increasing numbers of graduates with more than a secondary school education.
increasing.translationZh: 但战后，随着反法西斯战争的胜利，巨大的社会和政治变革应运而生，这使得欧美经济体对中学以上学历毕业生的需求日益增长。
increasing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

increasing.sentenceEn: The family's increasing poverty forced Dickens out of school at age 12 to work in Warren's Blacking Warehouse, a shoe-polish factory, where the other working boys mocked him as "the young gentleman."
increasing.translationZh: 家庭日益加剧的贫困迫使狄更斯在12岁时辍学，进入沃伦黑鞋油厂工作。在这家鞋油厂里，其他童工都嘲笑他是"小绅士"。

increasing.sentenceEn: Specialisation can be seen as a response to the problem of an increasing accumulation of scientific knowledge.
increasing.translationZh: 专业化可视为对科学知识日益积累这一问题的应对之策。

increasing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

increasing.sentenceEn: A comparison of British geological publications over the last century and a half reveals not simply an increasing emphasis on the primacy of research, but also a changing definition of what constitutes an acceptable research paper.
increasing.translationZh: 对比过去一个半世纪英国地质学领域的出版物，我们发现不仅对研究主导地位的重视程度日益提高，而且对于何为合格研究论文的定义也在不断变化。
increasing.paperLabel: 考研英语 2001 英语（未分卷）
increasing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

independence.sentenceEn: Rather than pulling students back, a gap year pushes them ahead by preparing them for independence , new responsibilities and environmental changes – all things that first-year students often struggle with the most.
independence.translationZh: 间隔年非但不会拖慢学生的脚步，反而能让他们领先一步——它帮助学生为独立生活、新的责任以及环境变化做好准备，而这些正是大一新生通常最难以应对的问题。
independence.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

independence.sentenceEn: Having made their wealth and their reputations elsewhere, they presumably have enough independence to disagree with the chief executive's proposals.
independence.translationZh: 由于他们在其他领域已经积累了财富和声望，因此想必拥有足够的独立性来对首席执行官的提议提出异议。
independence.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

independence.sentenceEn: The details may be unknowable, but the independence of standard-setters, essential to the proper functioning of capital markets, is being compromised.
independence.translationZh: 具体细节或许无法得知，但会计准则制定者的独立性——这对资本市场的正常运作至关重要——正在受到损害。
independence.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

independence.sentenceEn: Born in the crisis of the old regime and Iberian colonialism, many of the leaders of independence shared the ideals of representative government, careers open to talent, freedom of commerce and trade, the right to private property, and a belief in the individual as the basis of society.
independence.translationZh: 这些独立运动的领袖们诞生于旧政权和伊比利亚殖民主义的危机之中，他们大多怀有共同的理想：建立代议制政府、实行任人唯贤的仕途制度、保障商贸自由、承认私有财产权，以及坚信个人是社会的基石。
independence.paperLabel: 考研英语 2007 英语（未分卷）
independence.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

independence.sentenceEn: The ideals of the early leaders of independence were often egalitarian, valuing equality of everything.
independence.translationZh: 早期独立运动领袖们的理想常常带有平等主义色彩，他们珍视一切事物的平等。
independence.paperLabel: 考研英语 2007 英语（未分卷）
independence.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

independence.sentenceEn: To help homeless people toward independence , the federal government must support job training programs, raise the minimum wage, and fund more low-cost housing.
independence.translationZh: 为了帮助无家可归者实现独立生活，联邦政府必须支持职业培训项目、提高最低工资标准，并资助建设更多低成本住房。
independence.paperLabel: 考研英语 2006 英语（未分卷）
independence.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

initiative.sentenceEn: Your boss proposes a new initiative you think won't work.
initiative.translationZh: 你的老板提出了一项你认为行不通的新举措。
initiative.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

initiative.sentenceEn: Hagel says we have designed jobs in the U.S. that tend to be "tightly scripted" and "highly standardized" ones that leave no room for "individual initiative or creativity".
initiative.translationZh: 哈格尔指出，在美国，我们设计的工作往往是“严格按脚本执行”和“高度标准化”的，没有给“个人主动性或创造力”留下任何空间。
initiative.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

initiative.sentenceEn: Many employers have instituted weight loss and fitness initiatives .
initiative.translationZh: 许多雇主已实施了减肥和健身计划。
initiative.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

initiative.sentenceEn: In our rapidly changing economy, we more than ever need people in the workplace who can take initiative and exercise their imagination "to respond to unexpected events".
initiative.translationZh: 在我们瞬息万变的经济环境中，我们比以往任何时候都更需要那些在工作场合能够主动采取行动并发挥想象力以应对突发事件的人才。
initiative.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

initiative.sentenceEn: In South Africa, an HIV-prevention initiative known as loveLife recruits young people to promote safe sex among their peers.
initiative.translationZh: 在南非，一项名为“loveLife”的艾滋病预防倡议招募年轻人在同龄人中推广安全性行为。
initiative.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

initiative.sentenceEn: It seems clear that such a scheme is an initiative push toward what would eventually be a compulsory Internet "driver's license" mentality.
initiative.translationZh: 显然，这样的方案是朝着最终形成一种强制性互联网'驾照'思维模式迈出的主动一步。
initiative.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第3句

internal.sentenceEn: This will help to grow your internal network, in addition to being a nice break in the work day.
internal.translationZh: 这不仅能为你的工作日带来愉快的调剂，还有助于拓展你在公司内部的人脉网络。
internal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第6句

internal.sentenceEn: Manuscripts will be flagged up for additional scrutiny by the journal's internal editors, or by its existing Board of Reviewing Editors or by outside peer reviewers.
internal.translationZh: 期刊内部编辑、现有评审编辑委员会或外部同行评审员将标记出需要额外审查的稿件。
internal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

internal.sentenceEn: "Most journals are weak in statistical review, and this damages the quality of what they publish. I think that, for the majority of scientific papers nowadays, statistical review is more essential than expert review," he says, but he noted that biomedical journals such as Annals of Internal Medicine, the Journal of the American Medical Association and The Lancet pay strong attention to statistical review.
internal.translationZh: 他表示：“大多数期刊在统计审查方面较为薄弱，这损害了它们发表内容的质量。我认为，对于当今大多数科学论文而言，统计审查比专家审查更为关键。”但他也指出，像《内科医学年鉴》、《美国医学会杂志》和《柳叶刀》等生物医学期刊对统计审查给予了高度重视。
internal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

internal.sentenceEn: Today, the social sciences are largely focused on disciplinary problems and internal scholarly debates, rather than on topics with external impact.
internal.translationZh: 如今，社会科学研究在很大程度上侧重于学科内部的问题和学术争论，而非具有外部影响力的课题。
internal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

internal.sentenceEn: At its best, the European project is remarkably liberal: built around a single market of 27 rich and poor countries, its internal borders are far more open to goods, capital and labour than any comparable trading area.
internal.translationZh: 就其优势而言，欧盟一体化进程展现出显著的自由开放特征：它围绕着由27个贫富不一的国家组成的单一市场构建而成，其内部边界对商品、资本和劳动力的开放程度远超任何其他同类贸易区域。
internal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第3句

internal.sentenceEn: It applies equally to traditional historians who view history as only the external and internal criticism of sources, and to social science historians who equate their activity with specific techniques.
internal.translationZh: 这一点同样适用于传统历史学家和社会科学历史学家：前者将历史仅视为对史料的内外考证，后者则将其研究活动等同于特定的研究方法。
internal.paperLabel: 考研英语 1999 英语（未分卷）
internal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

investor.sentenceEn: Like other start-up investors , Mr. Arnold's own business often depends on selling start-ups to larger tech companies, though he admits to mixed feelings about the result: "I think these things are good for me, if I put my selfish hat on. But are they good for the American economy? I don't know."
investor.translationZh: 与其他初创企业投资者一样，阿诺德自己的业务也常常依赖于将初创公司出售给更大的科技企业，不过他承认对这样的结果心情复杂：“如果从个人私利出发，我觉得这些事对我有好处。但它们对美国经济有好处吗？我不确定。”
investor.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

investor.sentenceEn: Transient investors , who demand high quarterly profits from companies, can hinder a firm's efforts to invest in long-term research or to build up customer loyalty.
investor.translationZh: 那些要求公司实现高额季度利润的短期投资者，可能会妨碍企业投资长期研究或建立客户忠诚度的努力。
investor.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

investor.sentenceEn: When you remember such things you can automatically become an investor in their wellbeing.
investor.translationZh: 当你记住这些细节时，你自然而然就成为了关心他们福祉的人。
investor.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第18段，第1句

investor.sentenceEn: But banks' shares trade below their book value, suggesting that investors are skeptical.
investor.translationZh: 但银行股的交易价格低于其账面价值，这表明投资者对此持怀疑态度。
investor.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第4句

investor.sentenceEn: Many consumers seem to have been influenced by stock-market swings, which investors now view as a necessary ingredient to a sustained boom.
investor.translationZh: 许多消费者似乎受到了股市波动的影响，而投资者现在将这种波动视为经济持续繁荣的必要因素。
investor.paperLabel: 考研英语 2004 英语（未分卷）
investor.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

immune.sentenceEn: Nor are highly paid managers themselves immune from the harm caused by the ERA'S unjustified dismissal procedures.
immune.translationZh: 高收入经理自身也无法免受《雇佣关系法》中不当解雇程序带来的损害。
immune.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

immune.sentenceEn: For women, the association may be attributable to changes in immunity that resulted from excess abdominal fat; in men, the immune system did not appear to be involved.
immune.translationZh: 对于女性而言，这种关联可能源于腹部脂肪过多导致的免疫力变化；而对于男性，免疫系统似乎并未参与其中。
immune.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

immune.sentenceEn: It is like the immune system of the body, which under stress or through lack of nutrition or exercise can be weakened, but which never leaves us.
immune.translationZh: 它就像人体的免疫系统，在压力下或因缺乏营养、缺少锻炼而可能被削弱，但它永远不会离开我们。
immune.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

immune.sentenceEn: When there is rapid improvement in the price and performance of technology, jobs that were once thought to be immune from automation suddenly become threatened.
immune.translationZh: 当技术的价格不断下降且性能迅速提升时，那些曾经被认为不会受到自动化影响的工作岗位突然变得岌岌可危。
immune.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

immune.sentenceEn: Rodriguez notes that children in remote villages around the world are fans of superstars like Arnold Schwarzenegger and Garth Brooks, yet "some Americans fear that immigrants living within the United States remain somehow immune to the nation's assimilative power."
immune.translationZh: 罗德里格斯指出，世界各地偏远村庄的孩子们都崇拜阿诺德·施瓦辛格和加斯·布鲁克斯这样的超级巨星，然而“一些美国人却担心，生活在美国境内的移民会以某种方式不受这个国家同化力量的影响。”
immune.paperLabel: 考研英语 2006 英语（未分卷）
immune.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

implement.sentenceEn: States have begun implementing their own solutions to shore up protections for consumer-generated health data.
implement.translationZh: 各州已开始实施各自的解决方案，以加强对消费者生成的健康数据的保护。
implement.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

implement.sentenceEn: This might mean implementing policy such as a plastic tax that adds a cost to environmentally problematic action, or banning single-use plastics altogether.
implement.translationZh: 这可能意味着需要实施一些政策，例如征收塑料税，让那些对环境造成问题的行为付出代价，或者完全禁止一次性塑料制品。
implement.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

implement.sentenceEn: Sensible ideas have been around for a long time, but the state-level bodies that govern the profession have been too conservative to implement them.
implement.translationZh: 虽然合理的改革建议早已存在，但管理律师行业的州级机构却过于保守，不愿实施这些建议。
implement.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

implement.sentenceEn: He must use this surplus in three ways: as seed for sowing, as an insurance against the unpredictable effects of bad weather and as a commodity which he must sell in order to replace old agricultural implements and obtain chemical fertilizers to feed the soil.
implement.translationZh: 他必须以三种方式利用这些余粮：作为播种的种子，作为防备恶劣天气不可预测影响的保障，以及作为必须出售的商品，以便更换旧农具和购买化学肥料来滋养土壤。
implement.paperLabel: 考研英语 2000 英语（未分卷）
implement.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

implement.sentenceEn: Advertisers are willing to implement DNT.
implement.translationZh: 广告商愿意实施“不追踪”（DNT）机制。

indispensable.sentenceEn: John Fraser: Marris distorts our findings which actually prove that zoos serve as an indispensable link between man and nature.
indispensable.translationZh: 约翰·弗雷泽：马里斯歪曲了我们的研究结果，而实际上我们的研究证明动物园是人与自然之间不可或缺的纽带。
indispensable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第13段，第1句

indispensable.sentenceEn: Any writer needs to read as much and as widely as they can; it's the one indispensable supporter—something you can't do without.
indispensable.translationZh: 任何作家都需要尽可能多地广泛阅读；阅读是不可或缺的支撑——是写作过程中万万不能缺少的要素。
indispensable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

indispensable.sentenceEn: But policies to help workers adapt will be indispensable .
indispensable.translationZh: 但帮助工人适应变化的政策将不可或缺。
indispensable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第3句

indispensable.sentenceEn: "Idleness is not just a vacation, an indulgence or a vice; it is as indispensable to the brain as vitamin D is to the body…[idleness] is, paradoxically, necessary to getting any work done," he argues.
indispensable.translationZh: 他认为：“ idle并非仅仅是假期、放纵或恶习；它对大脑而言不可或缺，就像维生素D对身体一样……矛盾的是，要完成任何工作，idle是必不可少的。”
indispensable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

indispensable.sentenceEn: Marris distorts our findings which actually prove that zoos serve as an indispensable link between man and nature.
indispensable.translationZh: 马里斯歪曲了我们的研究结果，而实际上这些结果证明动物园是人与自然之间不可或缺的纽带。

inherent.sentenceEn: A Reddit webpage devoted to the phenomenon, boasting nearly 50,000 members, showcases images of local desire paths adorned with signs instructing pedestrians to adhere to designated walkways, underscoring the rebellious nature inherent in these human-made tracks.
inherent.translationZh: Reddit上有一个专门讨论这一现象的网页，拥有近5万名成员。该网页展示了各种本地“欲望小径”的图片，这些小径旁往往立着指示行人走指定步道的标牌，凸显了这些人为路径中固有的叛逆性质。
inherent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

inherent.sentenceEn: Good governance rests on an understanding of the inherent worth of each individual.
inherent.translationZh: 善治的基础是理解每个人的内在价值。
inherent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第5句

inherent.sentenceEn: If you're not convinced of the inherent value in taking a year off to explore interests, then consider its financial impact on future academic choices.
inherent.translationZh: 如果你还不相信休学一年探索兴趣的内在价值，那么不妨考虑一下它对未来学业选择的经济影响。
inherent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

inherent.sentenceEn: The fashion industry knows it has an inherent problem in focusing on material adornment and idealized body types.
inherent.translationZh: 时尚业深知，其过于注重物质装饰和理想化体型的做法存在固有问题。
inherent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

inherent.sentenceEn: Its inherent problems are getting worse.
inherent.translationZh: 其固有的问题正日益恶化。

initial.sentenceEn: Despite the exciting initial finds, the site would lie undisturbed for decades before archaeologists would return.
initial.translationZh: 尽管最初的发现令人振奋，但该遗址在考古学家再次前来之前，仍被尘封了数十年。
initial.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第7句

initial.sentenceEn: Honestly, if we got stuck in the rut of "hi", "hello", "how are you?" and "what is going on?", you will fail to give the initial jolt to the conversation that can make it so memorable.
initial.translationZh: 说实话，如果我们总是陷在“嗨”“你好”“最近怎么样”“在忙什么”这类陈词滥调中，就无法给谈话注入最初的活力，使其变得如此难忘。
initial.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第1句

initial.sentenceEn: For a social epidemic to occur, however, each person so affected must then influence his or her own acquaintances, who must in turn influence theirs, and so on; and just how many others pay attention to each of these people has little to do with the initial influential.
initial.translationZh: 然而，要形成一个社会流行潮，每个受到影响的人都必须接着去影响自己的熟人，而这些熟人又必须转而影响他们自己的熟人，依此类推；而有多少人会关注这些传播链中的每个人，与最初的影响者几乎没有关系。
initial.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

initial.sentenceEn: If people in the network just two degrees removed from the initial influential prove resistant, for example, the cascade of change won't propagate very far or affect many people.
initial.translationZh: 例如，如果社交网络中仅与初始影响者相隔两层的人表现出抵制态度，那么这一连串的变化就不会传播得很远，也不会影响很多人。
initial.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

initial.sentenceEn: More than three million doses were to be made available in early October 2009, though most of those initial doses were of the FluMist nasal spray type, which is not recommended for pregnant women, people over 50 or those with breathing difficulties, heart disease or several other problems.
initial.translationZh: 2009年10月初将提供超过300万剂疫苗，不过首批疫苗大多为" FluMist "鼻喷雾型，不建议孕妇、50岁以上人群、呼吸困难者、心脏病患者以及存在其他多种健康问题的人群使用。
initial.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第3句

initial.sentenceEn: Remember that your initial draft is only that.
initial.translationZh: 记住，你的初稿仅仅是初稿而已。
initial.paperLabel: 考研英语 2008 英语（未分卷）
initial.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

injury.sentenceEn: "Too much too soon either results in injury or burnout," says Mary Yoke, PhD, a faculty member in the kinesiology department at Indiana University in Bloomington.
injury.translationZh: 印第安纳大学布卢明顿分校运动机能学系教员玛丽·约克博士表示：“急于求成、过度运动要么会导致受伤，要么会让人精疲力尽。”
injury.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

injury.sentenceEn: The fewer the injury claims, the better the workman's insurance rate.
injury.translationZh: 工伤索赔越少，工人的保险费率就越优惠。
injury.paperLabel: 考研英语 1999 英语（未分卷）
injury.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

injury.sentenceEn: When the work is well done, a climate of accident-free operations is established where time lost due to injuries is kept at a minimum.
injury.translationZh: 如果这项工作做得好，就能建立无事故运营的良好氛围，将因工伤造成的时间损失降到最低。
injury.paperLabel: 考研英语 1999 英语（未分卷）
injury.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

injury.sentenceEn: As personal injury claims continue as before, some courts are beginning to side with defendants, especially in cases where a warning label probably wouldn't have changed anything.
injury.translationZh: 尽管人身伤害索赔案件依然如往常一样不断发生，但一些法院已开始站在被告一方，尤其是在那些即使有警示标签也可能无济于事的案件中。
injury.paperLabel: 考研英语 1999 英语（未分卷）
injury.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

injury.sentenceEn: The jury agreed that the nature of the game, not the helmet, was the reason for the athlete's injury .
injury.translationZh: 陪审团一致认为，造成该运动员受伤的原因是这项运动本身的特性，而非头盔。
injury.paperLabel: 考研英语 1999 英语（未分卷）
injury.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第5句

injury.sentenceEn: "We're really sorry he has become paralyzed, but helmets aren't designed to prevent those kinds of injuries ," says Nimmons.
injury.translationZh: 尼蒙斯表示：“对于他的瘫痪我们深感遗憾，但头盔的设计初衷并非为了防止此类伤害。”
injury.paperLabel: 考研英语 1999 英语（未分卷）
injury.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

insight.sentenceEn: But understanding where the animals were first domesticated could guide archaeologists to a narrow region to search for insights about the original tamed donkeys.
insight.translationZh: 但了解这些动物最初是在哪里被驯化的，可以引导考古学家前往一个狭窄的区域，去寻找关于最初被驯服驴类的见解。
insight.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

insight.sentenceEn: Urban planners interpret desire paths as more than just convenient shortcuts; they offer valuable insights into the dynamics between planning and behaviour.
insight.translationZh: 城市规划师认为， desire paths 不仅仅是便捷的捷径；它们还为理解规划与行为之间的动态关系提供了宝贵见解。
insight.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

insight.sentenceEn: Armed with this insight , the marketing and engineering teams joined forces to raise awareness by prominently promoting the premium version to users of the free version.
insight.translationZh: 基于这一洞见，市场营销团队与工程团队联手合作，通过向免费版用户重点推广高级版来提高用户认知度。
insight.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

insight.sentenceEn: The insight that curiosity can drive you to do self-destructive things is a profound one.
insight.translationZh: 好奇心会驱使人们做出自我毁灭的行为，这是一个深刻的见解。
insight.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

insight.sentenceEn: "Because US colleges and universities seldom acknowledge how social class can affect students' educational experiences, many first-generation students lack insight about why they are struggling and do not understand how students 'like them' can improve."
insight.translationZh: 由于美国高校很少承认社会阶层会如何影响学生的教育经历，许多第一代大学生并不清楚自己为何会陷入困境，也不明白像他们这样的学生该如何进步。
insight.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

insight.sentenceEn: Genetic analysis offers insight into the history of donkeys.
insight.translationZh: 基因分析为研究驴的历史提供了见解。

intelligent.sentenceEn: To put it another way: How can we make sure that the thinking of intelligent machines reflects humanity's highest values?
intelligent.translationZh: 换而言之：我们如何确保智能机器的思维能够反映人类的最高价值观？
intelligent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第1句

intelligent.sentenceEn: We think of it simply as a healthy and helpful flow of intelligent thought.
intelligent.translationZh: 我们不妨将其简单理解为一种健康有益的智慧思维流。
intelligent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

intelligent.sentenceEn: The subtle and intelligent little book The Marketplace of Ideas: Reform and Resistance in the American University should be read by every student thinking of applying to take a doctoral degree.
intelligent.translationZh: 《思想市场：美国大学的改革与抵制》这本精妙而睿智的小书，值得每一位考虑申请攻读博士学位的学生一读。

intelligent.sentenceEn: Together with another two scientists, he is publishing a paper which not only suggests that one group of humanity is more intelligent than the others, but explains the process that has brought this about.
intelligent.translationZh: 他与另外两位科学家合作发表了一篇论文，不仅提出人类中某一群体比其他群体更聪明，还解释了造成这一现象的过程。
intelligent.paperLabel: 考研英语 2008 英语（未分卷）
intelligent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

intelligent.sentenceEn: The idea that some groups of people may be more intelligent than others is one of those hypotheses that dare not speak its name.
intelligent.translationZh: 某些人群可能比其他人群更聪明的观点，是那种不敢公之于众的假设之一。
intelligent.paperLabel: 考研英语 2008 英语（未分卷）
intelligent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

intelligent.sentenceEn: In his article "How Intelligent Is Intelligence Testing?", Sternberg notes that traditional tests best assess analytical and verbal skills but fail to measure creativity and practical knowledge, components also critical to problem solving and life success.
intelligent.translationZh: 在其《智力测试有多智能？》一文中，斯滕伯格指出，传统测试能很好地评估分析能力和语言能力，却无法衡量创造力和实践知识，而这些也是解决问题和人生成功的关键要素。
intelligent.paperLabel: 考研英语 2007 英语（未分卷）
intelligent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

interpersonal.sentenceEn: The main disadvantage of using AI to respond to customers is that there are concerns about trusting personal interactions to machines, which could lead not only to the subsequent loss of interpersonal connections, but also to a decrease in marketing personnel.
interpersonal.translationZh: 使用人工智能回应客户的主要缺点在于，人们对于将人际互动交由机器处理存在顾虑，这不仅可能导致后续人际连接的丧失，还可能造成营销人员的减少。
interpersonal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

interpersonal.sentenceEn: But snap decisions in reaction to rapid stimuli aren't exclusive to the interpersonal realm.
interpersonal.translationZh: 但是，对快速刺激做出的瞬时决策并不局限于人际交往领域。
interpersonal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

interpersonal.sentenceEn: The researchers' argument stems from a simple observation about social influence: With the exception of a few celebrities like Oprah Winfrey – whose outsize presence is primarily a function of media, not interpersonal , influence – even the most influential members of a population simply don't interact with that many others.
interpersonal.translationZh: 研究人员的观点源于对社会影响力的一个简单观察：除了少数像奥普拉·温弗瑞这样的名人——他们的巨大影响力主要源于媒体而非人际影响——即使是一个群体中最具影响力的人物，实际上也不会与那么多人产生互动。
interpersonal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

interpersonal.sentenceEn: Building on this basic truth about interpersonal influence, the researchers studied the dynamics of social influence by conducting thousands of computer simulations of populations, manipulating a number of variables relating to people's ability to influence others and their tendency to be influenced.
interpersonal.translationZh: 基于这一人际影响的基本事实，研究人员通过对人群进行数千次计算机模拟，操纵了若干与人们影响他人的能力以及被他人影响的倾向相关的变量，以此来研究社会影响的动态变化。
interpersonal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

interpersonal.sentenceEn: The kinds of interpersonal violence that women are exposed to tend to be in domestic situations, by, unfortunately, parents or other family members, and they tend not to be one-shot deals.
interpersonal.translationZh: 不幸的是，女性遭受的人际暴力往往发生在家庭环境中，施暴者多为父母或其他家庭成员，而且这些暴力行为往往不是一次性的。
interpersonal.paperLabel: 考研英语 2008 英语（未分卷）
interpersonal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第5句

intervention.sentenceEn: Schwitzgebel predicted the intervention would have no effect; he had previously found that ethics professors do not differ from other professors on a range of behaviors, including voting rates, blood donation and returning library books.
intervention.translationZh: 施维茨格贝尔曾预测这种干预不会产生任何效果；他此前发现，伦理学教授在一系列行为上与其他教授并无不同，包括投票率、献血行为和归还图书馆书籍的情况。
intervention.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

intervention.sentenceEn: "That's actually a pretty large effect for a pretty small intervention ," Schwitzgebel says.
intervention.translationZh: 施维茨格贝尔表示：“对于如此微小的干预而言，这实际上是相当显著的效果。”
intervention.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

intervention.sentenceEn: Their thesis – that a relatively modest intervention could have a big impact – was based on the view that first-generation students may be most lacking not in potential but in practical knowledge about how to deal with the issues that face most college students.
intervention.translationZh: 他们的论点——一项相对简单的干预措施可能会产生重大影响——基于这样一种观点：第一代大学生最缺乏的可能不是潜力，而是如何应对大多数大学生所面临问题的实用知识。
intervention.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

intervention.sentenceEn: In any case, all such interventions are heavily dependent on scientific advice and also scientific and technological manpower of all kinds.
intervention.translationZh: 无论如何，所有这类干预措施都在很大程度上依赖于科学咨询以及各类科技人才。
intervention.paperLabel: 考研英语 2000 英语（未分卷）
intervention.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第6句

investigate.sentenceEn: The researchers investigated one class session's impact on eating meat.
investigate.translationZh: 研究人员调查了一节课对肉类食用的影响。
investigate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

investigate.sentenceEn: After a spouse has been selected, each family investigates the other to make sure its child is marrying into a good family.
investigate.translationZh: 选定配偶后，双方家庭会互相考察，以确保自己的孩子能嫁入或娶入一个好家庭。
investigate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第5句

investigate.sentenceEn: Otherwise, academics will continue to think dangerously alike, increasingly detached from the societies which they study, investigate and criticise.
investigate.translationZh: 否则，学术界人士的思维将继续危险地趋同，与他们所研究、调查和批判的社会日益脱节。

investigate.sentenceEn: Earlier this year the country's Defence Advanced Research Projects Agency announced plans to pay Boeing to investigate formation flight, though the programme has yet to begin.
investigate.translationZh: 今年早些时候，美国国防高级研究计划局宣布计划资助波音公司研究编队飞行技术，不过该项目尚未启动。
investigate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

investigate.sentenceEn: Dr. Kroo says this is one of the areas his team will investigate further.
investigate.translationZh: 克鲁博士表示，这是他的团队将进一步研究的领域之一。
investigate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

investigate.sentenceEn: Biological factors behind eye contact are being investigated
investigate.translationZh: 眼神交流背后的生物学因素正在研究中
